"You can, you have to be able to, and in the worst case, your father will step in."

chapters.title: Chapter 562: Looking at the End
paragraphs: The reason the Patriarch had not done anything for now was never because Rhaenar was incapable.
If he decided to go to the heart of the prison, probably none of the inner layers would be able to stop him for long.
But the entry of a Celestial into the deepest part of Verendal’s hidden structure was not something that could be kept secret under the current circumstances.

To open a path for him to enter, the oldest formations of the city would have to be activated at full power; systems that the world considered part of Verendal’s defense would reveal their true nature.
Worse than that, the reaction of the imprisoned creature itself could no longer be hidden.
Now, outside the city, several Overlords, a Celestial from the Primal Firmament, representatives of the Federation, and experts from almost all of the world’s greatest powers were present.
If Rhaenar was forced to enter the prison himself, there was a high chance that the several-hundred-year-old secret of the Pendragons would end that very day.
Everyone would find out.
The Demon of End had never been killed, and this would be the biggest damage to their reputation and could cause very serious damage to their name.
On top of that, no one knew how Kairos would react.
That was why the Patriarch was the last option.
The hidden path eventually brought them back to a place Lian had not expected.
The ceremony altar.
The same huge field where thousands of people had been sitting around it in the morning.
Now it was empty.
In the center of the field, the Dragon Mark was still floating three meters above the altar; an irregular black piece with golden lines running across its surface.
Lian looked around.
In the morning, this place had been a place for celebration, politics, and showing power, but now its silence even felt uncomfortable.
Isolde looked at Seris.
"Your hand."
Seris walked toward the altar, and when she was less than one meter away from the Dragon Mark, the Ancestral Mark on her hand lit up again.
This time, the pain did not return as strongly.
But Lian saw the muscles of her forearm become tense for a moment.
She raised her palm, and a golden light formed between her hand and the main mark.
Now it was the Matriarch’s turn to quietly start whispering several special sentences.
The first stone ring on the ground shook and then rose from the ground.
She took several steps back.

The ring stood vertically, then behind it came the second, then the third, and one after another, all six huge rings separated from the floor of the altar and positioned themselves inside each other in the air.
Each ring started rotating in a different direction, and thousands of golden symbols appeared on the surface of the stone.
A deep sound spread across the entire field, and then a crack appeared in the ground as if a part of space itself had been completely removed.
There was no depth that could be seen inside it, as if it had no end at all and there was only absolute darkness.
A few seconds later, a golden line appeared inside that darkness and began to expand.
And it turned into a narrow path that extended from the altar to a place much lower.
Lian looked toward its end.
"From here, you go."
Seris stepped onto the path without hesitation, her mark became brighter, there was no resistance, and she walked several steps into the darkness without any problem and then turned back.
Her eyes fell on Lian, as if she was telling him to come too.
It was his turn.
Lian took his first step, and at that exact moment, a golden network appeared in front of him.
Voom!
The barrier formed so quickly that it stopped only a few centimeters in front of his face.
He raised an eyebrow.
Behind him, Isolde became silent, and for a moment, even she seemed to think that Rhaenar had made a mistake.
But suddenly, something inside the body of the Young Vorhelm moved like a beating heart, and with a closer look, it became clear that it was the Eclipse Core.
Thump.
Lian looked down.
The Eclipse Essence began to flow for a moment without his direct command and moved through his hand.
A black line appeared under his skin, and the golden network reacted, its light became stronger, but it did not attack.
The Eclipse Essence moved close to the defensive layer, and for a fraction of a second, the golden and black energies came into contact.
Then the network moved back, but surprisingly, its structure was neither damaged nor disabled, instead, it opened by itself.
Lian looked at the opened path for several moments.
Then he looked at Isolde.
For the first time, the woman was looking at him completely without hiding it, not as one of the Vorhelms, but as if she was looking at an unknown creature.
An unknown creature that might be hiding very great secrets, perhaps even secrets greater than their own, and now she herself at least understood part of the reason Rhaenar had chosen him.
But she asked no questions, this was not the time.
"Come back safely, both of you," she only said.
Lian stepped inside, and the rings closed behind him.
The sound of the world disappeared.
For several seconds, he could only hear his own footsteps and Seris’s, while a golden path extended through the absolute darkness.
There were no walls on either side of them and no ceiling above them, as if they were in space, except that there was a staircase.
Sometimes huge mana rings could be seen at very far distances; they were so far away that their real size could not be understood.
Some were several hundred meters in diameter and perhaps even larger, and all of them were slowly rotating in the darkness.
The Young Vorhelm said nothing for several minutes, as if he was trying to analyze exactly what kind of place they were in.
Then he gave Seris a quick look.
"How much do you know about the Demon of End?"
"Little, except that they say it is called the Demon of End because it is the embodiment of the end of everything."
Lian nodded.
If they were talking about a creature that the ancestors of the Pendragons had supposedly killed to stop it, then it was obvious that they were not talking about an ordinary monster.
"Do your family’s reports mention anything about its power? Or at least its level?"
This time, Seris stayed silent a little longer.
"I don’t know."
He looked at her, and she did not take her eyes off the path.
"Apparently, many things I knew were lies." Her voice was still cold.
He could understand that the problem was not only a historical truth.
The Pendragons were something Seris was proud of, her ancestor, the generations before her, and the legends she had heard since childhood.
Now, a part of that same history had broken beneath her feet.

As for its power, all of humanity had to hope that even if it was released, its level would at least not be above 80, because if that happened, the fall of the European continent could be considered certain.
After some time, the golden path started becoming wider.
The darkness around them also changed, not because it became brighter, but because something in the distance started taking shape.
Seris slowed her steps first.
Lian noticed the reason one second later, the golden path had ended and the real prison was in front of them.
For several moments, his mind could not properly understand the size of what he was seeing.
The word "prison" brought the image of walls, gates, and chains to the mind.
This looked nothing like that, it was more like a world that had been created only to imprison one creature.
Above them was endless darkness, there was no ceiling and no sky.
Even if you looked thousands of kilometers away, there was still only dark space.
From a sea of red mist below, pillars rose up, each one large enough to compete with the huge towers of Verendal.
Hundreds of meters?
More?
It was difficult to tell.
Chains were stretched between the pillars.
At first, Lian thought the distance had made their rings look larger, but then he realized he was wrong.
Each ring really was several meters thick and dozens of meters long, the metal of the chains was black, but rivers of golden light flowed inside their grooves.
Every time the light moved from one ring to the next, thousands of symbols on its surface lit up.
Some chains disappeared into the darkness above, some sank into the red sea below, and some were connected to something at the center of this world.
He still could not see it completely.
Below them, the red mist slowly moved, a huge wave traveled from one side of the prison to the other.
A few seconds later, it repeated in the same pattern.
Lian frowned, this was not wind ... wind had no meaning here ... so was it breathing? Something inside the mist was breathing.
The darkness in front of them moved for a moment.
Or at least he thought it moved, and then part of a black surface rose and went down again.
His eyes slowly adjusted to the space of the prison.
First, he saw a scale.
The Young Vorhelm only looked at it for several seconds.
It was longer than his own height, then he realized there were dozens of other scales beside it, reaching hundreds and thousands.
The thing that had looked like a black wall in the distance a few moments ago was not a wall.
It was a body.
A huge neck had risen from the mist and was restrained by five golden rings, two chains as large as huge bridges were wrapped around it.
A little farther away, part of one of the wings could be seen; a wing with several huge pillars passing through its dark membrane and pinning it to the space of the prison.
Its end could not even be seen.
A broken horn came out from the head of the creature, it was as large as a damn tower, and at the center of its chest was something golden.
A huge spike that if you placed a multi-story building beside it, it would look small.
It had passed through the dragon’s chest, and hundreds of chains and lines of light were connected from its end to different points of the prison.
For several moments, Lian even slowed his breathing.
This was the Demon of End.
( Scene visualization )

chapters.title: Chapter 563: The One Behind The Game
paragraphs: This was the Demon of End.
And every time its chest rose, thousands of chains were pulled, and the sound of metal passed through the entire world of the prison.
Grrrrrrrr...
That sound alone was enough for Lian to feel a very weak vibration in the bones of his chest.
The world had said that this creature had been killed centuries ago, the history books had written the same thing.
The reports of the Federation, researchers, the great families, and even the count of hunted Demon Rank creatures were all based on the same claim.
But the creature that was supposed to be one of the greatest victories in human history was breathing right in front of them.

"Maybe it was only in my imagination, but I didn’t think it would really be the End itself, when I look at it, I feel like I’m looking at the End, the end of everything, the end of the world, the end of time, and the end of existence."
"I feel like nothing can exist after this creature, because it is the End."
Seris stood beside him, she did not reject his words, because she had exactly the same feeling, as if they were looking at the end of every concept.
Her right hand was wrapped around the handle of her sword, too tightly, and she stared at the dragon.
Maybe she was comparing the images she had created in her mind since childhood with what she was seeing now.
The Pendragon heroes, the dead dragon, victory, pride, and the reality in front of them were a little different.
"At least your ancestors still managed to defeat it," Lian said.
Young Pendragon gave him a quick look and their eyes met for several seconds.
"Anyway, what should we do now?"
He also did not want to let this Demon be released under any circumstances, and it was better for them to stop its release as soon as possible.
She said nothing and only turned forward again, after a few steps, her hand around the handle of her sword became a little looser.
The Ancestral Mark lit up again.
The girl stopped.
The light became weaker.
Then, when she took half a step to the right, it became brighter again.
Seris looked at a narrow path between two huge pillars.
"That way."
Lian followed her without asking a question, and the farther they went, the clearer part of the seal structure became.
And then he saw something that did not belong to the rest, a very thin silver thread moving across one of the black chains.
If the golden light of the prison had not lit it from that specific angle, it might not have been seen at all.
He moved closer.
[True Sequence]
His eyes focused on the structure, unfortunately, the information did not appear in front of him as a simple window, this skill was not always going to give him a ready answer.

But it allowed him to see the paths, the main structure of the chain was almost impossible to understand, thousands of layers with each command placed on top of another and thousands of mana paths connected to each other.
Something that probably several generations of the strongest Pendragon experts had created and then improved.
But the silver thread did not belong to it, instead, it was sitting on top of the network.

Not by force, as if it was using the paths of the seal itself, and with even greater precision, it seemed that whenever a golden command passed through the chain, the silver thread recorded part of it.
As if it was copying the structure and then returning an almost identical version to the network with a very small change.
Lian frowned, this logic was familiar.
Not because he had seen it before, but because he had spent several hours hearing about a certain artifact, this damn thing was acting exactly like the Thousand-Faced Mirror artifact.
Seris stood beside him, looking at the thread for several seconds.
"Primal Firmament?"
"It seems like it."
If such a structure really came from the same technology, then maybe this time the answer was truly the thing right in front of them.
The silver thread moved along the chain and they followed it.
The farther they went, the more the prison looked like the remains of an old battlefield rather than a structure that had been built afterward.
The first thing they saw was hundreds of swords, they were buried in a black field and were broken and burned.
Some only had their handles left and some still had a very weak light flowing along their edges.
The names of many of them were carved into their bases, Pendragon... Pendragon again... and again.
Lian looked at one of the broken blades, these were not decorations, someone had fought here and someone had died here.
A little farther ahead, a huge piece of armor was lying on the ground.
The center of the armor’s chest was completely crushed and nothing remained inside it.
On the other side, one of the main pillars of the prison was broken in the middle.
Lian raised his head, on a distant wall, five marks could be seen.
At first, he thought they were cracks, but then he saw the distance between them, they were claw marks from a monster that had struck it.
Just one of those marks was nearly a hundred meters long.
He slowed his steps for a moment.
The Demon of End had once been free here and had fought, this entire world was not originally a prison that had been built beforehand.
It was part of a battlefield where the ancestors of the Pendragons had later built the seal, every chain, pillar, and golden ring was placed over an old wound.
This family had not simply thrown the Demon into a cell, they had turned the entire place where it had been defeated into a prison.
The Eclipse Core pulsed again.
Thump.
Lian stopped, this time the reaction was not to the Demon of End itself, along the way, he had felt the presence of the Demon Rank from every part of the prison.
Its pressure was everywhere, but this pulse had come from ahead.
Seris also raised her hand almost at the same time, her Ancestral Mark became brighter and both of them looked in the same direction.
No dialogue was needed.
They started moving and their steps became faster, the silver threads also became more numerous.
One.
Three.
Ten.
Slowly, they had spread across the chains like foreign veins and all of them were going in the same direction, at the end of the path, the ground ended.
In front of them, a huge black platform was floating above the sea of red mist, there was no bridge, but when she stepped forward, her mark shone and a golden path came out of the empty space.
They crossed it.
The closer they got, the stronger the Eclipse Core reacted.
At the center of the platform was the heart of the prison, and thousands of golden rings were rotating in different directions around a black core.
Some were horizontal and some were vertical and some had angles that gave the mind a strange feeling if you looked at them for too long.
Every time two rings passed beside each other, a network of golden symbols formed between them and then disappeared again.
The entire prison was powered from this point.
And right in the middle of all this, there was something small that was silver in color.
At first glance, it even looked ridiculous, a seed about the size of a fingertip with a smooth and shiny surface.
But thousands of silver threads came out of that same seed.
They had entered the rings, the chains, the energy paths, and even some of the golden lines beneath their feet.
Lian understood with only one look, this was the center, whatever had infected the prison was spreading from here.
Seris pulled out her sword, and the sound of the blade leaving its sheath was unusually clear in the huge space of the prison.
The Young Vorhelm also took one step forward, but then... stopped.
He felt that something was watching them, but his instincts gave no warning.
Something was wrong.
If a living creature was waiting in ambush, even if it was much stronger than him, his instincts would usually at least give him some sign of danger.
Here? Nothing.
But the feeling of being watched did not disappear.
Seris noticed his stop a moment later, she took her eyes off the seed and looked in the same direction Lian was looking.
Behind the golden rings, farther away, at first only a thin shadow could be seen, but then one of the rings rotated and golden light passed over it.
And someone’s face became visible for a moment, long silver hair, pale skin, a thin body, and two long ears coming out from between the hair.
But it was not a Pendragon, it was not even a damn human.
The creature stood motionless among the lights of the prison and its eyes reflected the gold of the rings like the surface of a mirror.
Lian did not even blink.
In his mind, all the faces that had accused each other since morning came together for a moment.
Stormheart, Vorhelm, Primal Firmament, the Six Great Families, the Twelve Ancient Guilds.
Everyone had been looking for a traitor on the other side.
Everyone thought that one of the powers on Earth had started the game and now, behind the corrupted heart of the prison, a Silver Elf woman was standing.
At that moment, a simple and humiliating truth became clear in his mind, none of those powers were controlling the game.
They had all been pawns in the game from the very beginning.

At first, he thought they were cracks, but then he saw the distance between them, they were claw marks from a monster that had struck it.
Just one of those marks was nearly a hundred meters long.
He slowed his steps for a moment.
The Demon of End had once been free here and had fought, this entire world was not originally a prison that had been built beforehand.
It was part of a battlefield where the ancestors of the Pendragons had later built the seal, every chain, pillar, and golden ring was placed over an old wound.
This family had not simply thrown the Demon into a cell, they had turned the entire place where it had been defeated into a prison.
The Eclipse Core pulsed again.
Thump.
Lian stopped, this time the reaction was not to the Demon of End itself, along the way, he had felt the presence of the Demon Rank from every part of the prison.
Its pressure was everywhere, but this pulse had come from ahead.
Seris also raised her hand almost at the same time, her Ancestral Mark became brighter and both of them looked in the same direction.
No dialogue was needed.
They started moving and their steps became faster, the silver threads also became more numerous.
One.
Three.
Ten.
Slowly, they had spread across the chains like foreign veins and all of them were going in the same direction, at the end of the path, the ground ended.
In front of them, a huge black platform was floating above the sea of red mist, there was no bridge, but when she stepped forward, her mark shone and a golden path came out of the empty space.
They crossed it.
The closer they got, the stronger the Eclipse Core reacted.
At the center of the platform was the heart of the prison, and thousands of golden rings were rotating in different directions around a black core.
Some were horizontal and some were vertical and some had angles that gave the mind a strange feeling if you looked at them for too long.
Every time two rings passed beside each other, a network of golden symbols formed between them and then disappeared again.
The entire prison was powered from this point.
And right in the middle of all this, there was something small that was silver in color.
At first glance, it even looked ridiculous, a seed about the size of a fingertip with a smooth and shiny surface.
But thousands of silver threads came out of that same seed.
They had entered the rings, the chains, the energy paths, and even some of the golden lines beneath their feet.
Lian understood with only one look, this was the center, whatever had infected the prison was spreading from here.
Seris pulled out her sword, and the sound of the blade leaving its sheath was unusually clear in the huge space of the prison.
The Young Vorhelm also took one step forward, but then... stopped.
He felt that something was watching them, but his instincts gave no warning.
Something was wrong.
If a living creature was waiting in ambush, even if it was much stronger than him, his instincts would usually at least give him some sign of danger.
Here?
Nothing.
But the feeling of being watched did not disappear.
Seris noticed his stop a moment later, she took her eyes off the seed and looked in the same direction Lian was looking.
Behind the golden rings, farther away, at first only a thin shadow could be seen, but then one of the rings rotated and golden light passed over it.
And someone’s face became visible for a moment, long silver hair, pale skin, a thin body, and two long ears coming out from between the hair.
But it was not a Pendragon, it was not even a damn human.
The creature stood motionless among the lights of the prison and its eyes reflected the gold of the rings like the surface of a mirror.
Lian did not even blink.
In his mind, all the faces that had accused each other since morning came together for a moment.
Stormheart, Vorhelm, Primal Firmament, the Six Great Families, the Twelve Ancient Guilds.
Everyone had been looking for a traitor on the other side.
Everyone thought that one of the powers on Earth had started the game and now, behind the corrupted heart of the prison, a Silver Elf woman was standing.
At that moment, a simple and humiliating truth became clear in his mind, none of those powers were controlling the game.
They had all been pawns in the game from the very beginning.

chapters.title: Chapter 564: A Silver Elf
paragraphs: A few seconds of silence ruled over the prison.
Lian did not take his eyes off the creature standing among the huge golden rings.
Long silver hair, long ears, and eyes that reflected the light around them like mirrors; none of them matched the human race.
A Silver Elf, and as far as he knew, based on common knowledge and the knowledge of the Vorhelm Family, this thing was one of the natives of the Heavenly Realm.
But her presence here, in the deepest part of one of the most secret places on Earth, was stranger than her appearance itself.
How had she entered?
As far as he knew, humans needed certain conditions to enter the Heavenly Realm, and traveling between the two worlds was not as simple as passing through a normal gate.
Even Awakened below Level Sixty were not allowed to enter that realm, and it had never been heard of that a creature from that world could enter their world.
However, one of the residents of that same world was now standing in front of him.
Seris pulled out her sword.
The sound of metal spread through the huge space of the prison, and a faint silver light appeared along the edge of the blade.
"Who are you?"
The Elf looked at her sword and then fixed her mirror-like eyes on Lian’s face.
"I did not expect humans to reach this place, at least not this soon."
It was not an answer to the question.
Lian also had no intention of waiting for the creature to decide to behave more politely.
He activated [True Sequence].
The flow of mana around the Elf appeared in his perception, and almost at the same moment, something strange became clear.
The structure in front of him was not a body.
There was no blood flow, no life core, and no natural mana circulation could be seen.
What kept the Elf-shaped body together was a collection of commands made from mana that came from the silver seed between the seal rings.
The thing in front of them was not real, more exactly, the closest thing to it was a clone.
Lian narrowed his eyes slightly.
"So you really are not here."
The female Elf stayed silent for a moment, then the corner of her lips rose.
"Sharp."
She gave a small shrug.
"For someone who managed to make the Six Great Families and the Twelve Guilds fight each other, I expected you to at least come personally to see the result of your work."
But this made one thing clear, this Elf was truly not in their world, but had somehow managed to send a clone.
"Why should I risk my life to do something that can be done from this distance?"
It was not a bad answer.
Especially for a creature that had managed to bypass Verendal’s security network without being physically present.
"How did you come to our world?"
Seris took one step forward.
The Elf looked at her.
"You humans really think that only you can enter other worlds?"
This time, her tone was somewhere between contempt and amusement.
Seris did not ask another question, but Lian could understand that the creature’s answer was intentionally incomplete.

The fact that this Elf was a clone only explained that she was not physically present in the prison and in this world, it was still unclear how the clone had reached Earth and how long she had been inside the Pendragon network.
The answer to that question probably had a lot of value, not just value, it could also prevent more threats from entering their world.
The only problem was that they did not have enough time to find it for now.
The Elf’s eyes stopped on Seris’s Ancestral Dragon Mark.
The mirror-like light in her eyes changed for a moment, and then she looked at the rings at the heart of the prison.
"Are you trying to stop this friend from waking up?
Lian checked the seed from the corner of his eye, the thing that seemed to be placed at the center of the seal.
Thousands of thin threads came out of it and entered the golden structure of the seal.
Some were only on the surface, but several thicker threads had moved close to the central rings.
The Elf noticed the direction of his gaze.
"We were supposed to have more time, but now that you have arrived, there is no reason to be careful anymore."
As soon as her sentence changed, a sword with destructive power was thrown toward her.

The Elf only gave a smirk, and the sword passed through her without any problem, as if she was nothing more than a ghost, then she turned her eyes toward the person who had made that attack, Seris, and gave a mocking smirk.
But she said nothing and continued with her work.
The sword returned to its owner’s hand, and the Young Pendragon frowned.
"Looks like physical attacks cannot hurt her."
Lian immediately felt the change in the flow of mana, they had an even bigger problem for now.
"Seris, get ready."
The Elf raised her hand.
The seed at the center of the rings began to spin.
Thousands of silver threads lit up at the same time and spread along the chains and seal pillars like veins carrying fresh blood.
The golden light of several rings became weaker for a moment, then one of the main mana paths changed direction.
And then... Boom!
A heavy sound came from deep inside the prison.
The young Vorhelm turned his eyes toward the huge creature imprisoned in the sea of red mist.
One of the chains connected to the neck of the Demon of End trembled.
Not because of the dragon’s movement, but because the energy inside it had greatly decreased.
The Silver Elf had moved the operation forward.
If she had previously needed several hours to weaken the seal, now she intended to do the same thing in a few minutes, caution no longer mattered.
Lian took a short breath, so there was no more time for further investigation.
"Seris, do you see the chain on the left?"
Seris nodded.
"I will remove its corruption caused by those silver threads, you return the chain to the main flow of the seal again."
The girl moved without asking any questions.
He focused his eyes on the silver threads.

The main structure of the seal, even with all its complexity, had a clear logic, the golden commands moved along fixed paths and transferred the stored energy in the pillars to the restraining chains.
But the silver threads recorded part of these commands before they reached their destination, then an almost identical version, with a small change, entered the flow again.
As a result, a chain that was supposed to become stronger lost part of its own energy.
It was not direct destruction, but it was more like changing the commands, this was somewhat similar to what happened to the cells of the body and caused cancer.
It could even be compared to a genetic mutation.
This was the reason the corruption could pass through the defensive layers.
The network still seemed to be following its own commands, only the result of some commands was no longer what their creators wanted.
Lian raised his right hand and the Eclipse Core began to spin.
Some Eclipse Essence was released from his limited supply and moved through his body.
The golden light of the prison was reflected on the metal rings, pillars, and even the shiny surface of the silver threads.
For most creatures, this was only light and brightness.
But for him?
There were hundreds of different paths formed from the light.
The Corrupted Sun responded to his perception.
He chose several paths, paths where the existing light passed over the surface of the corruption without directly touching the main structure of the seal.
The color of the light changed.
Black lines appeared inside the white light and moved along the paths of the reflected network.
The light became corrupted.

But this time Lian did not stop there, and five very thin threads made from Eclipse Essence separated from the paths, and each one reached one of the main centers where that silver corruption was spreading and forming.
Tssss!
The first center turned black and the second cracked, the third lost its organized structure almost immediately after contact.

The Eclipse Essence was not supposed to destroy the golden chain, his goal was simple, with the help of Eclipse Essence, he destroyed from inside every structure that was causing the corruption of these chains.
The chains were the seals of the Demon of End, and the Silver Elf was trying to weaken them enough for the dragon to wake up and destroy them.
But he was not going to let that happen, and in less than a few seconds, the silver threads on the first chain began to collapse.
"Now!" Lian shouted.
Seris placed her right hand on one of the golden paths, and the Ancestral Dragon Mark lit up.
The main command that had been hidden under the false layer until a moment ago appeared again, and with the contact of her Mark, it began to flow.
Energy moved from the pillars of the prison, and the silent grooves of the chain lit up one after another.
The sound of huge metal being pulled spread through the prison, and the chain became tight again.
Seris slightly pressed her teeth together.
Lian noticed.
Activating that path again was not without a cost.

Although her Mark only restored the main command and the energy came from the prison’s own reserves, the pressure of the commands passing through the Ancestral Dragon Mark was still transferred directly to her body.
But Seris did not back away.
"Next."
He looked at her.
The girl was still holding her hand up, and her expression was cold.
Then she turned toward the second chain.
"Right side, we do the same thing."
They had to continue until all the chains were restored again.
Seris nodded.
The second chain also began to light up.
For a moment, Lian truly thought they might be able to remove an important part of the corruption before the dragon woke up.
But the Silver Elf had not stayed silent this whole time.
Her eyes moved between Lian, Seris’s Mark, and the restored chains.
There was no longer any sign of her earlier amusement on her face, she lowered her hand and then stared at the main structure of the prison seal for several seconds.
"So even this much is not enough."
He turned his head toward her, and the Elf gave a very small smile.
"Let’s see if you can work this well after she wakes up too."
All the silver threads connected to one of the distant pillars lit up at the same time.
Lian saw the change with [True Sequence], and the energy stolen from other parts was suddenly transferred to that same pillar.
It seemed she wanted to strike the seal with one huge attack at once, an attack so large that it could cause the Demon to wake up.
"Seris, back!"
It was too late.
The golden light of the huge pillar went out, and the chain connected to the neck of the Demon of End became loose.
Then the second chain...
Krrrrrrrack!
A breaking sound came from a very far distance, but it was so heavy that the platform under their feet shook.
Lian raised his head, and in the sea of red mist, part of one of the dragon’s huge wings moved.
It was a very small movement, but that movement pulled hundreds of chains.
The dragon was waking up...

chapters.title: Chapter 565: Facing A Demon!
paragraphs: Several golden pillars in the distance lit up and released more energy to hold back the pressure.
The chest of the Demon of End rose, and this time it rose more than before.
His next breath caused the sea of red mist to move back in a huge wave.
And then one of his closed eyelids moved and slowly opened, revealing a huge eye with a dark red iris.
For a moment, that eye stayed still, and then its pupil narrowed.
Grrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr!
The roar of the Demon of End spread through the entire prison.
The sound pressure passed through the pillars.
The golden rings shook, and several damaged platforms in the distance collapsed.
Lian had no time to think.
[Molten Bastion Body]
At the same moment, he also activated his Ancient-rank armor.
[World-Devourer Bastion]
Huge armor plates formed over his chest, shoulders, and arms, the dark metal lines settled over each other, and its heavy weight matched his strengthened body.
He stood in front of Seris.
His feet became firm against the stone.
Mountain Frame and Mountain Anchor helped increase his resistance.
However...Boom!
The wave of the roar hit them.
He was pushed several meters backward across the stone.
Deep lines appeared under his feet, and one of the armor plates on his shoulder cracked.
The Young Pendragon drove her sword into the stone to keep her balance, but even she was forced to put one knee on the ground.
When the pressure faded, Lian felt the taste of blood in his mouth, part of the damage had been transferred to his body.
And that was only a roar, one damn roar!
And worse than that, the monster was not at its peak, otherwise that roar would have killed both of them.
The Demon of End raised his huge head.
Most of his body was still connected to the golden chains, the huge central spike still passed through his chest, and most of his energy was being suppressed by the ancient seals.
But one of his front limbs was free.
Only one limb.
Claws, each one taller than a high tower, opened in the air of the prison.
The dragon looked at his own chains for several seconds, and then at the seal covered by the silver threads, and his attention focused exactly on those silver threads.
And finally, the Silver Elf.
His deep voice came out from between his huge teeth.
"You have awakened, Your Highness."
The Elf raised her head and spoke with the greatest respect, Elves were a very proud race, and she was the same.
But the creature in front of her was a god-like existence, she had to show the greatest respect.
The Demon of End moved his neck slightly forward, and his huge eye stayed on the structure of the Elf for a moment.
It was as if he had understood the entire situation in those few seconds.
Someone was opening his prison, and two humans were trying to stop it.
"Continue."
The dragon’s voice spread through the entire prison.
The Elf said nothing, and the Demon moved his eyes toward Lian and Seris.
"I will keep these two busy."
His free claw moved.
Lian understood at that moment that the claw was not trying to follow him, the dragon was first testing the range of its movement.
His huge arm rose through the red mist and moved toward the platform at the heart of the seal.
But there was still some distance left when the chains connected to his shoulder and chest were pulled tight.
The movement of the claw slowed for a moment, and several golden seals on the dragon’s arm lit up.
The Demon of End turned his head slightly, changed the angle of his shoulder, and this time sent the claw from a lower direction.
He was measuring the limits of his own prison, and he quickly understood how much freedom he had gained.
Predator’s Instincts warned Lian at that exact moment.
"Seris, left!"
The girl moved without asking any questions.
And he also left his previous position with [Ashen Thunder Step].
A moment later...Boom!
The huge claw hit the western edge of the platform at the heart of the seal, and hundreds of meters of black stone were shattered.
A deep crack moved from the point of impact to near the central rings, and part of the platform fell into the sea of red mist.
The pressure wave reached their bodies even after they moved away.
Lian landed on a remaining piece of ground and bent his knees to absorb the force of the landing.
When he raised his head, a large part of their path back no longer existed.
The dragon had destroyed almost one-third of the battlefield without even freeing his main body.
But he had also noticed something else, the claw could not move beyond a certain range.
The chains on his shoulder and chest did not allow it.
So if they stayed aware of that range, they could predict his movements, the only problem was that, that range was still very large.
Seris landed on the other side of the crack and raised her sword, mana came out from behind her shoulders and gathered several meters away from her body.
A huge crescent took shape.
[Moon Manifestation]
The cold moonlight fell over the broken stones.
Lian immediately felt the change in her mana, it was more condensed and more organized, and what he had seen during the morning training was now taking shape on a much more serious scale.
With every movement of her sword, part of the released energy returned to the moon-shaped image, and the moon became more complete, and as a result, the power of the girl’s next attack increased.
The Demon of End raised his claw again, and this time he moved it directly toward Seris.
Apparently, those few seconds had been enough for him to understand which of the two could restore the chains.
Lian saw the movement.
"Seris, move away, go toward the eastern pillar!"
The Young Pendragon nodded, but she did not make a simple retreat, she held her sword with both hands.
[Sovereign Judgment]
A huge silver light gathered on the blade.
When the claw came down, she moved out of its direct path and at the same moment brought her sword down from above.
A heavy slash hit the outer part of one of the dragon’s fingers.
Clang!
The sound was more like two huge pieces of metal hitting each other than a sword hitting flesh, and even the black scale under the attack did not break.
But the path of one of the fingers was moved a few degrees, and instead of hitting the eastern path directly, the claw destroyed the edge of the previous crack.
Seris was thrown several meters backward by the force of the impact, but she turned her body in the air and landed on the stone.
Lian gave a quick look at the place of impact, so even her attacks could not easily pass through its scales.
Of course, this was not strange, that creature was a Demon.
If a Level 20 Awakened could easily cut through its skin, the Pendragon ancestors would not have sacrificed so many lives to stop it.

This monster was not at its peak, it had been imprisoned for centuries and had slowly weakened, and even the seals had made it weaker year after year, but that did not mean the two of them could defeat it.
A Demon was still a Demon.
But the attack was not completely useless, and those few degrees of deviation were exactly what they needed.
Lian moved from where he had landed.

The Ancient-rank armor was still on his body, and its damaged plates were slowly repairing themselves, but [Structural Memory] could not restore the entire armor as quickly as the Demon could damage it.
He knew this very well, so he had no intention of trying to fight the dragon’s claw with strength.
His goal was something else.
Near one of the joints of the claw, several old scales were broken and part of the tissue under them was exposed.
It was damage from the battle several centuries ago, if he wanted to leave an effect on the body of the Demon of End, that was the best place.
Ice gathered along his right fist.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
Claws made from condensed cold formed around his armored fist.
He increased his speed.
[Ashen Thunder Step] burned around his feet, and in one fast movement, he crossed the distance between himself and the dragon’s falling finger.
His fist hit the damaged area.
Boom!
The cold spread along the crack in the scale.
Part of the outer layer of the wound froze, and pieces of the old black tissue broke apart.
But at that exact moment, the force of the impact moved from Lian’s fist to his shoulder, and his teeth pressed together.
The armor on his forearm cracked.
It was as if instead of flesh and bone, he had punched a mountain made from the strongest steel in the world, even though he was not even an Awakened.
He jumped back, even the damaged area was this strong, however, he had achieved his goal to some degree.
The layer of ice remained on the joint and slowed the movement of that finger for a moment.
He used this delay.
"Seris, third chain! Now!"
The girl, who had reached the eastern pillar, placed her Mark on the golden path, and light rose from inside the stone.
The chain connected to the Demon’s shoulder became slightly tighter.
The dragon noticed the change and turned his head toward the Young Pendragon.
"You smell like those cowardly and stupid Pendragons."
After hearing the Demon’s words about her family, Seris’s eyes became colder, she could not accept her ancestors being called cowards.
However, the dragon did not care about her feelings, and his mouth opened.
And Lian immediately understood that the next attack was no longer the claw.
A dark red light gathered deep inside the throat of the Demon of End.
Not normal fire, but condensed mana that was strongly destroying the area around it, even before being released, the red mist under the dragon’s mouth moved back.
He saw the path of the attack, Seris was not far from the point of impact.
But her Mark was still connected to the seal’s flow, and if she cut the connection at this moment, the chain would become loose again.
Damn it.
He brought his hand forward.
[Eternal Grave Maw]
Five jaws formed around the head of the Demon of End and tried to keep his mouth closed.
But that thing was a Demon!
The jaws did not even last for one second before falling apart.
Lian frowned for a moment when he saw that, but it did not matter, because another idea came to his mind.

At the same moment, three other huge jaws appeared in the path of one of the golden chain rings, and when they closed around the center of the corrupted section, they held back the silver flow for a moment.
This gave Seris enough time to cut the connection between her Mark and the chain without losing the progress they had made in removing the corruption from the third chain.
But the Demon’s attack was ready.
"Seris, let it go!"
At that moment, the dragon released his breath, and a huge pillar of red energy was fired toward the girl.
Lian moved toward her with [Ashen Thunder Step].
But the distance was too great, and he would not reach her in time!

sentences.text: Several golden pillars in the distance lit up and released more energy to hold back the pressure.
The chest of the Demon of End rose, and this time it rose more than before.
His next breath caused the sea of red mist to move back in a huge wave.
And then one of his closed eyelids moved and slowly opened, revealing a huge eye with a dark red iris.
For a moment, that eye stayed still, and then its pupil narrowed.
Grrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr!
The roar of the Demon of End spread through the entire prison.
The sound pressure passed through the pillars.
The golden rings shook, and several damaged platforms in the distance collapsed.
Lian had no time to think.
[Molten Bastion Body]
At the same moment, he also activated his Ancient-rank armor.
[World-Devourer Bastion]
Huge armor plates formed over his chest, shoulders, and arms, the dark metal lines settled over each other, and its heavy weight matched his strengthened body.
He stood in front of Seris.
His feet became firm against the stone.
Mountain Frame and Mountain Anchor helped increase his resistance.
However...Boom!
The wave of the roar hit them.
He was pushed several meters backward across the stone.
Deep lines appeared under his feet, and one of the armor plates on his shoulder cracked.
The Young Pendragon drove her sword into the stone to keep her balance, but even she was forced to put one knee on the ground.
When the pressure faded, Lian felt the taste of blood in his mouth, part of the damage had been transferred to his body.
And that was only a roar, one damn roar!
And worse than that, the monster was not at its peak, otherwise that roar would have killed both of them.
The Demon of End raised his huge head.
Most of his body was still connected to the golden chains, the huge central spike still passed through his chest, and most of his energy was being suppressed by the ancient seals.
But one of his front limbs was free.
Only one limb.
Claws, each one taller than a high tower, opened in the air of the prison.
The dragon looked at his own chains for several seconds, and then at the seal covered by the silver threads, and his attention focused exactly on those silver threads.
And finally, the Silver Elf.
His deep voice came out from between his huge teeth.
"You have awakened, Your Highness."
The Elf raised her head and spoke with the greatest respect, Elves were a very proud race, and she was the same.
But the creature in front of her was a god-like existence, she had to show the greatest respect.
The Demon of End moved his neck slightly forward, and his huge eye stayed on the structure of the Elf for a moment.
It was as if he had understood the entire situation in those few seconds.
Someone was opening his prison, and two humans were trying to stop it.
"Continue."
The dragon’s voice spread through the entire prison.
The Elf said nothing, and the Demon moved his eyes toward Lian and Seris.
"I will keep these two busy."
His free claw moved.
Lian understood at that moment that the claw was not trying to follow him, the dragon was first testing the range of its movement.
His huge arm rose through the red mist and moved toward the platform at the heart of the seal.
But there was still some distance left when the chains connected to his shoulder and chest were pulled tight.
The movement of the claw slowed for a moment, and several golden seals on the dragon’s arm lit up.
The Demon of End turned his head slightly, changed the angle of his shoulder, and this time sent the claw from a lower direction.
He was measuring the limits of his own prison, and he quickly understood how much freedom he had gained.
Predator’s Instincts warned Lian at that exact moment.
"Seris, left!"
The girl moved without asking any questions.
And he also left his previous position with [Ashen Thunder Step].
A moment later...Boom!
The huge claw hit the western edge of the platform at the heart of the seal, and hundreds of meters of black stone were shattered.
A deep crack moved from the point of impact to near the central rings, and part of the platform fell into the sea of red mist.
The pressure wave reached their bodies even after they moved away.
Lian landed on a remaining piece of ground and bent his knees to absorb the force of the landing.
When he raised his head, a large part of their path back no longer existed.
The dragon had destroyed almost one-third of the battlefield without even freeing his main body.
But he had also noticed something else, the claw could not move beyond a certain range.
The chains on his shoulder and chest did not allow it.
So if they stayed aware of that range, they could predict his movements, the only problem was that, that range was still very large.
Seris landed on the other side of the crack and raised her sword, mana came out from behind her shoulders and gathered several meters away from her body.
A huge crescent took shape.
[Moon Manifestation]
The cold moonlight fell over the broken stones.
Lian immediately felt the change in her mana, it was more condensed and more organized, and what he had seen during the morning training was now taking shape on a much more serious scale.
With every movement of her sword, part of the released energy returned to the moon-shaped image, and the moon became more complete, and as a result, the power of the girl’s next attack increased.
The Demon of End raised his claw again, and this time he moved it directly toward Seris.
Apparently, those few seconds had been enough for him to understand which of the two could restore the chains.
Lian saw the movement.
"Seris, move away, go toward the eastern pillar!"
The Young Pendragon nodded, but she did not make a simple retreat, she held her sword with both hands.
[Sovereign Judgment]
A huge silver light gathered on the blade.
When the claw came down, she moved out of its direct path and at the same moment brought her sword down from above.
A heavy slash hit the outer part of one of the dragon’s fingers.
Clang!
The sound was more like two huge pieces of metal hitting each other than a sword hitting flesh, and even the black scale under the attack did not break.

Of course, this was not strange, that creature was a Demon.

chapters.title: Chapter 566: Ant Vs Dragon
paragraphs: But did Seris really need help?
The Moon Manifestation behind the girl quickly became brighter, and her sword rose, there was no sign of fear or worry on her face.
On the contrary, if there was anything there... it was excitement?
[Heavenfall]
A huge attack fell from above onto the path of the mass of energy coming toward her, and the silver and red light collided.
Krrrrraaaash!
She could not stop the attack, the difference in power was too great.
But the path of the fired mass of energy was split open for a moment, and that opening was enough.
She pulled herself through the space that had been created and moved out of the main attack range with several fast movements.
A moment later, the red energy hit the platform behind her.

The eastern wall collapsed along the path of the attack, and part of the supporting pillar broke with a huge sound, but that was not all, that mass of energy tore through space itself like paper and passed through it as well.
Lian reached Seris exactly when the second wave of pressure was released, he put his arm around her waist and used [Ashen Thunder Step] to take both of them out of the path.
When they landed at a safer distance, one of the armor plates on his side had turned red.
The heat had passed through the gaps and burned his skin.
The Young Pendragon was also breathing heavily, part of her sleeve had burned away and exposed her pale skin.
But the sword was still in her hand.
"Can you continue?"
The young Vorhelm looked at her.
Seris nodded.
"Yes."
Then he turned his eyes back toward the Demon of End, they had restored two chains.
But during this time, a large part of the platform had been destroyed, and one of the main pillars had been damaged.
If they continued like this, there would be no place left to stand before they could finish removing the corruption.
If the enemy was stronger, then they would gain an advantage through numbers, and it was time to use more forces.
He activated the special connection of the colony.
[Hive Dominion]
Two links responded.
First, the space behind him moved like a wave, and then a huge creature with dense black armor appeared from it.
One.
Ant Of Ruins.
The huge ant turned its head toward Lian as soon as it appeared, but when it saw Seris, its entire behavior changed.
Its antennae rose, its jaws moved together several times in excitement, and it lowered its huge head toward the girl.
A sound like happy clicking came from its mouth.
She, whose eyes were still on the dragon, turned around for a moment.
"One, it has been a while."
Hearing her voice, the ant became even more excited and moved its body slightly forward, as if it wanted to get closer to her, as if it wanted the girl to pet it.
Lian gave the two of them a quick look, did this bastard really prefer Seris over him right now?
Betrayal in broad daylight and this obvious?
"I’m very happy that you two are happy to see each other, but this is not a good time."
One moved its antennae.
Almost at the same time, the second link responded.
A huge wolf with dead black and gray fur and an unusual bone covering appeared behind them.
Two.
Wolf of Eight Disasters.
He looked at Seris once, made no movement and showed no special reaction, and then turned his head toward the Demon of End.
The fur on the back of his neck rose, and a very low growl came from his chest.
Lian felt his instinctive pressure through the colony link.
Two had recognized the danger, what was in front of him was not just a stronger monster.
It was a Demon, something at the top of the power chain of all monsters.
However, he had no plan to retreat, even if it meant his death, he had to follow his master’s orders.
Lian looked toward the battlefield and ordered them to move, and they moved.
The Demon of End turned his huge head slightly when he saw the two new creatures, and his eyes stayed on Two for a moment.
"Fallen monsters?"
There was contempt in his voice.
"Have humans even made these things their slaves?"
Lian gave no answer and focused on checking the claw’s next movement.
The dragon opened his huge fingers and attacked the healthy part of the central platform again.
But this time One moved forward and his black armor lit up, gray mana came out from behind his body and gathered at six points.
Six huge semi-material arms formed behind the ant’s armor, and each one had a different structure.
[Six Hands of Ruin]
The first arm came down.
[Fault Hand]
Boom!
The ground under part of the secondary platform split.
A deep crack formed along the path of the claw’s movement, and a huge piece of stone that was supposed to support the dragon’s fingers moved from its place.
Instead of hitting a stable surface, the claw landed on the collapsing part.
The direction of the attack changed, but its power was still very great, and the Demon crushed the entire piece of stone with more pressure.
One moved his second arm at the same moment.
[Collapse Hand]
The attack focused on the already cracked part of the stone, and the structure of the stone broke from inside, turning the huge piece under the claw into several parts.
The dragon lost the balance of his claw for a moment, not because One was stronger, but because the point where the claw was pressing no longer existed.
Lian used the opportunity.
"Seris, the chain behind the shoulder!"
The girl nodded and moved.
But the Demon of End also understood their goal, and his mouth lit up again.
The huge ant raised his third arm, he was not going to let his master’s plan fail.
[Ruinfall Hand]
A heavy attack hit the mass of broken stones.
Hundreds of huge pieces were thrown into the air by the force and created a wall of debris in the path of the dragon’s mouth.
A moment later, the red energy was released and most of the stones melted in the first collision, even space cracked in some places and tears could be seen between the layers of reality.
But the red wave lost its direct path for a fraction of a second, and that fraction of a second was enough for Seris to move.
The Wolf of Eight Disasters was not idle either, he raised his head and activated one of the Eight Disasters.
[Blood Hunt Moon]
A red mark appeared in the wolf’s perception on the old damage of the dragon’s claw joint, the same place where Lian had struck earlier with Glacial Reaper Claw.
Two used that mark to follow changes in the movement of the claw.
When the dragon tried to pull it out from the debris, the wolf jumped to the right before the movement was complete.
Then another disaster was activated.
[Bodiless Pack]
Several semi-real images of black wolves appeared around the claw, and each one attacked the same damaged joint from a different direction.
The Demon of End lowered his eyes, and red energy came out from between the scales of his claw, several bodiless images were destroyed at that exact moment.
The wolf jumped backward, and at the same time, One activated his fourth arm.
[Cascade Rupture Hand]
The semi-material arm struck the stones that had already cracked under the claw, and the cracks connected to each other in one path.
The break moved from the first section to the nearby pieces and caused the rest of the place supporting the claw to collapse.
Now the dragon was forced to raise his claw higher, exactly what Lian wanted.
"Two, back!
One, get ready for the next attack!"
But the dragon no longer intended to let them continue playing with the ground, and his huge fingers closed together.
Then, with a movement much faster than before, he slammed the claw directly toward the huge ant.
Lian’s Predator’s Instinct warned him, but the distance was too great.
One brought his fifth arm forward.
[Aftershock Hand]
The first attack hit part of the dragon’s black claw, although it caused no break, the second wave was released immediately after it.
Boom!
The delayed pressure hit the same point and slowed the movement of the claw for a moment.
The ant managed to pull his body back, but the dragon changed the path of the attack at the same moment, and the edge of one of the fingers hit One’s side.
Kraaak!
His armor plates cracked, his body was dragged several meters across the stone, and one of his legs bent under the pressure.
Lian felt his pain through the link.
"One!"
The ant was still alive, but the attack had truly injured him.
"Weak and pathetic, you dare face this exalted one?"
The Demon of End lowered his head further.
Then he raised his claw to finish the next attack.
But Two entered from the other side at extremely high speed, he was not going to let his senior die.
[Bone Mountain]
A huge mass of black bones rose between the claw and One, and the claw struck it.
The Bone Mountain shattered.
Hundreds of pieces of it spread through the air, and a large part of the structure was destroyed in less than a second.
But that short barrier saved One.
Lian reached the ant with [Ashen Thunder Step].
But he did not force him to enter the battle directly again.
"One, stay beside Seris and help her remove the corruption from the chains."
Then he gave an order to the Wolf of Eight Disasters.
"You also do not engage directly, just change the paths of his attacks."
None of them, not even himself, had the ability to face that Demon directly.
A direct confrontation was simply courting death.
Two lowered his head.
The young Vorhelm took a short breath, they were still at the beginning of this battle.
And the Demon of End, while a large part of his body was still tied to the chains, had almost managed to remove one of the special members of the colony from the battlefield with two moves.
If the main seals were damaged any further, even these short opportunities would disappear.
Seris had reached the eastern pillar.
The Ancestral Dragon Mark on her hand lit up, and the golden path rose from the stone floor to the top of the pillar.
Lian could still see the silver threads connected to it.
If they remained like this, the new energy she put into the path would once again be destroyed by the silver corruption.
So first, he had to destroy them.
But the Demon of End was now focusing all his attention on that same pillar.
So how exactly was he supposed to do this?

Hundreds of pieces of it spread through the air, and a large part of the structure was destroyed in less than a second.
But that short barrier saved One.
Lian reached the ant with [Ashen Thunder Step].
But he did not force him to enter the battle directly again.
"One, stay beside Seris and help her remove the corruption from the chains."
Then he gave an order to the Wolf of Eight Disasters.
"You also do not engage directly, just change the paths of his attacks."
None of them, not even himself, had the ability to face that Demon directly.
A direct confrontation was simply courting death.
Two lowered his head.
The young Vorhelm took a short breath, they were still at the beginning of this battle.
And the Demon of End, while a large part of his body was still tied to the chains, had almost managed to remove one of the special members of the colony from the battlefield with two moves.
If the main seals were damaged any further, even these short opportunities would disappear.
Seris had reached the eastern pillar.
The Ancestral Dragon Mark on her hand lit up, and the golden path rose from the stone floor to the top of the pillar.
Lian could still see the silver threads connected to it.
If they remained like this, the new energy she put into the path would once again be destroyed by the silver corruption.
So first, he had to destroy them.
But the Demon of End was now focusing all his attention on that same pillar.
So how exactly was he supposed to do this?

chapters.title: Chapter 567: The Light Turns Black
paragraphs: When Seris reached her hand forward, the dragon turned its huge head toward her.
Lian saw this movement.
It was trying to target Seris again.
He had to change its attention.
[Myriad Presence Mirage] activated.

Five fake presences with mana signatures similar to his appeared in different parts of the broken platform, he could use another version of the skill, but in a situation like this, it was completely useless.
At the same time, he spread [Abyss Veil] over himself and changed his movement path.
For a moment, the Demon of End looked at one of the fake presences, but almost at the same moment, it realized its mistake.
"Do you think these childish tricks will work on me?"
Lian came out from behind a broken pillar.
"Not really."
And he pulled back his armored fist.
[Iron Fortress Charge]
His body moved toward the damaged part of the claw with great speed, and at the last moment, he also focused the power of [Glacial Reaper Claw] on his right fist.
BOOOOOOM!
The attack hit the old crack in the scale directly, and this time, a piece of that damaged scale broke off.

Of course, it was not a piece from the healthy part of the Demon’s body, but only the part that had been cracked for centuries, but even that was enough to stop the movement of the finger for a moment.
The Demon of End lowered its head.
The young Vorhelm immediately jumped backward, his opponent was so powerful that he could not hit it twice in a row, and this could put his life in direct danger.
Another claw passed beside his body and crushed the stone behind him.
The edge of the attack hit one of his armor plates, and a strong pain spread through his side, however, he did not waste the opportunity.
[Thunder Calamity]
Thunder mana gathered along his left arm and hit the damaged area of the claw from such a close distance.
Huge lightning spread across the black scales.
The healthy part of the dragon’s body was almost unharmed, but the electricity reached the open crack and made the muscles of that joint contract for a moment.
Lian moved backward.
At that exact moment, Seris entered from the right.
[King Breaker]
The silver sword struck the same area with great force.
CLANG!
One of the damaged layers of the scale broke, and a piece of black scale as large as a human fell from the dragon’s body.
Dark blood came out from the crack, but only a few drops.
The Demon of End stopped moving for a moment, and then a deep roar came from its chest.
This time, it was truly angry.
"Insects..."
The dragon opened its mouth.
Lian felt the pressure of mana.
"Back!"
But this time, the Demon did not intend to target only one straight path.
Red energy came out from between its huge teeth, and before turning into a focused pillar, it released a wave of pressure throughout the area.
Lian immediately tried to create layers and a complete defensive area around himself with the help of [Frost Dominion].
It reached dozens and then hundreds of layers, and for a moment, the two mana flows resisted each other.
But the difference in quality and power was too great.
His ice domain could not completely stop even the first wave and only broke part of the direct pressure.
At that moment, he activated [Cataclysm Pulse] and slammed his fist onto the ground with all his strength.
His only target was the pressure that had been created.
BOOOOOOM!
The pressure wave hit the red energy and pushed part of it to the sides.
The ground beneath Lian’s feet cracked, the edges of the armor on his chest opened, and blood flowed from the corner of his mouth.
It was still not enough.
And the dragon released its main attack.
Lian clenched his teeth.
[Eternal Frozen Apocalypse]
An enormous cold spread from his body.
The black stones across a wide area were covered under a thick layer of ice. Columns of dense ice rose in the path of the red energy, and part of the red mist around the platform froze.
Within a few seconds, the battlefield turned into a land of ice and broken stones.
Then... the red pillar hit it.
KRRRRRAAAAAASH!
The first ice wall turned into steam, the second one broke ...the third resisted for a moment, but a deep crack appeared in its center and the pressure of the attack passed through it.
He was forced to move backward again.
Eternal Frozen Apocalypse, a skill of the Divine rank, was enough to destroy the battlefield against many enemies.
Here? It had only bought a few seconds, but those few seconds gave Seris a chance.
"Lian!"
He heard the girl’s voice and raised his head.
The Moon Manifestation behind her was almost halfway complete, and cold light fell from its surface onto the battlefield.
Seven huge crescents formed around the girl, and each crescent took a separate path.
The first three crescents hit the remaining wave of red energy from both sides and above, and they shattered almost immediately.
The other four crescents moved through the steam and ice.
One changed the path of the attack, the second kept the passage open, and the last two crescents stood in front of Lian.
Seris herself moved through the opening at great speed, and just before the remaining pressure reached him, she moved her sword.
[Silver Requiem]
Dozens of silver slashes separated from the blade within a few moments.
The goal was not to injure the dragon, such a thing was impossible, the goal was to cut apart the last part of the wave that was approaching Lian.
Silver and red light collided.
The attack wave broke in the middle and passed around them from both sides.
The young Vorhelm looked at Seris for a moment, the girl did not even turn toward him, she only lowered her sword and looked toward the eastern chain.
She knew the work was not over yet.
"That was just in time, thank you."
Seris nodded, this man had saved her several times, now it was her turn to do this at least once.
Lian also returned to his work.
One was still standing near her.
Part of his side armor was broken and the movement of one of his legs was slower, but the five remaining arms were still coming out from behind his body.
The sixth arm was preparing for the final attack.
Through the Colony Link, Lian felt that part of the force from the previous impacts had been stored inside the ant’s armor.
The stored amount was not large, but it was enough for one attack.
The Demon of End raised its claw again.
"One, the broken pillar on the left!"
The ant immediately turned, the Six Hands of Ruin lit up at the same time for a moment, and the sixth arm moved forward.
[Ruin Verdict Hand]
All the stored Ruin energy was focused into one point.
The huge ant released it against the damaged base of one of the old prison pillars, a pillar that had not been part of the main seal network for a long time.
KRRRRRAAAAAASH!
The base shattered.
The cracks that already existed on the surface of the pillar connected to each other, and a huge part of it collapsed toward the path of the claw.
Stones as large as houses fell from above.
Instead of retreating, the Demon of End turned its claw toward the pillar.
DOOOOOM!
A large part of the stones were crushed by one strike, but the path of the claw changed, and the attack that was supposed to hit Seris directly struck the ground farther away.
The pressure wave made One’s armor shake again.
More cracks appeared on his side, and the six half-material arms disappeared one after another.
Lian felt his pain and exhaustion.
"That’s enough, One, don’t push yourself anymore.
The ant moved backward, it still had the strength to fight, but it should not take another impact like that.
On the other side, Two raised his head.
[Skyless Howl]
The howl spread through the prison, and a wave of spiritual pressure moved toward the dragon’s head.
The Demon of End immediately broke through it, but that single moment disturbed the movement of its neck.
The young Vorhelm did not waste the opportunity.
"Seris, complete the chain now!"
The Ancestral Mark lit up.
Golden threads moved along the eastern chain, and the silent sections joined the flow again.
The chain was pulled with a heavy sound, and the dragon’s shoulder was pulled several meters lower.
The Demon of End let out an angry roar, but this time, it could no longer bring its claw to the same distance as before.
Another part of the seal had been restored.
Lian took a deep breath, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth with the back of his hand, and looked at the rings around the heart of the prison.
The corruption was still active, and the Silver Elf had been working silently the entire time.
Every part that Lian cleansed, the creature tried to go around it through another path, if this continued, even with One and Two’s help, they would eventually become exhausted.
He had to act more efficiently, he raised his eyes.

Thousands of golden rings were shining throughout the prison, light was reflecting from the surface of the chains, from the pillars, from the shiny surface of the silver threads, even from the edge of Seris’s sword and the ice he had created...
And suddenly, an idea came to his mind.
Why should he only use five energy threads?
The Corrupted Sun’s ability was different, he could corrupt the existing light with Eclipse energy, through the paths he was able to detect.
So he did not need to target all the corruption points with only five threads.
He could destroy the five main centers of corruption with Eclipse energy threads and use the reflected light to wear down the weaker connections.
The only problem was energy consumption.
The Eclipse Core’s energy reserve was not unlimited, and even now, a considerable amount of its stored energy had already been used.
But if he was going to lose in this prison, saving energy for later had no meaning.
Lian raised his right hand, golden light reflected across his armor plates, and the Eclipse Core began to rotate faster.
And then the color of the light began to change.
At first, the change was very small, a black streak appeared on one of the golden surfaces.
Then a second.
A third.
The light continued moving through the prison at its normal speed, but it was no longer completely golden.
White light mixed with black spread through the reflected paths.
In less than a few seconds, dozens of paths of light passed above Lian’s head and spread like dark lines among the huge rings of the prison.
The Silver Elf raised her head, for a moment, even she did not understand what was happening.
Until the first silver thread turned black.
TSSSSSS!
Its structure collapsed from the inside.
The second thread did the same.
The corrupted light moved across the reflective surface of the corruption, and at the moment of contact, the Eclipse energy wore down its mana structure.
The young Vorhelm sent the five Eclipse threads toward the main nodes, and all five reached their targets.
But unlike before, this time, only five points were not damaged.
The corrupted lights moving through the other paths also reached the weaker connections and destroyed them one after another.
For a few moments, the appearance of the prison changed.
Among the enormous golden rings, black streaks were moving.
From a distance, it looked as if darkness was flowing inside the light itself, and wherever that light reached the silver network, the corruption collapsed.
The Silver Elf quickly raised her hand and began changing the paths of the corrupted silver threads.
But several threads were destroyed before the new command could reach them.
One of the main rings that had been dim until then lit up again with bright gold.
Lian slowly let out his breath, the Eclipse Core had lost a large amount of energy, but the result was worth it.
He had succeeded in cleansing several corruption paths at the same time, and right at that moment, a strange roar came from the direction of the Demon of End.
"Eclipse...?"
