chapters.title: Chapter 568: The Power That Shouldn’t Belong to a Human
paragraphs: "Eclipse...?"
Lian raised his head, the Demon of End had stopped the movement of its claw.
Its huge red eye was no longer focused on Seris, it was not even looking at the newly repaired chains.
All of its attention was on the black and white lines moving through the golden light of the prison.
For a few seconds, it did nothing.
Then it pushed its neck forward as far as the chains allowed.
"This..."
Unlike before, there was no anger in the dragon’s voice, instead, there was something close to disbelief in it.
"Is this Eclipse energy?"
The young Vorhelm did not lower his hand.
There were still several corrupted threads left, and he had to destroy them.
"How?!" the Demon of End said louder this time.
Its huge head moved forward, and the chains around its neck were pulled with a terrifying sound.
"How can a human use Eclipse energy?!"
Lian gave it a short look.
Even the Silver Elf stopped controlling the corruption for a moment and looked more carefully at the corrupted light.
Apparently, neither of them had expected to see something like this.
But the dragon’s reaction was different, to it, this was not just some unknown energy, it knew it, and it knew it very well.
"That power belongs to a Demon!"
This time, its voice shook the entire prison.
"Impossible! Where did you get it?!"
Lian sent one of the Eclipse threads toward another center of corruption.
Tess!
The center collapsed, and then he calmly said.
"I don’t think now is a good time for questions and answers."
The Demon of End stayed silent for a few moments, and then anger returned to its huge face.
"Arrogant human..."
He gave a faint smile, but something else was going through his mind, so the Demon of End knew the original owner of Eclipse energy.
But that was not strange either, and it was something he could easily guess, he was more curious about how well these two knew each other.
And more importantly, how a Demon would react to a human who could use the power of Demons.
The Silver Elf moved again, this time, there was no smile on her face.
"Enough."
The corruption spread at a much faster speed.
The threads that Lian had not yet had the chance to destroy suddenly separated from the secondary paths and moved toward one of the main chains.
Lian saw the change, all the energy gathered in the corrupted sections was being moved to one point.
The chain connected to the free arm of the Demon of End, the elf wanted to give the dragon more freedom of movement by destroying that chain.
"Seris! The left arm’s chain!"
The girl moved at that exact moment, but the distance was too great, and before she reached it, the corruption rewrote the main command of the chain.
The golden light at the connection point went out, and a loud sound came from the huge metal.
KRRRRRAAAAAACK!
One of the main rings broke away from its anchor.
The chain moved freely through the air for a moment, and then struck one of the pillars with great force.
The upper part of the pillar broke, and the Demon of End let out a victorious roar.
Its arm was freer, and now it could move it much farther than before, and this was very bad news.
Its huge head also rose several dozen meters, and the pressure of its presence increased.
One unconsciously took several steps backward, and Two let out a short roar.
Lian immediately understood that the situation had changed.
If the dragon’s arm reached the platform again, there would be nothing left of the center of the seal for them to repair.
The Demon of End opened its mouth, and red energy gathered inside it, its target was Seris.
The girl was standing right beside the broken connection point.
Lian did not even wait for the attack to fully form, and gray lightning flared around his legs.
He reached her in one movement.
He put his arm around the girl’s waist, and before the red wave was fully released, he moved both of them away from the area.
BOOOOOOM!
The dragon’s attack passed beside them, and the pressure wave hit the plates of his armor, breaking part of his shoulder armor, and a sharp pain moved up to his neck.
He landed on a lower platform with his teeth clenched.
The young Pendragon immediately moved away from him, and her eyes stayed on Lian’s injured arm.
"Your arm."
He closed his fingers once, it hurt, a lot, but he could still make a fist.
"It works."
The girl said nothing, and Lian turned his eyes back toward the broken chain, he could no longer solve the problem with only speed and physical strength.
"What should we do now?" she also frowned.
He needed something that could restrain the Demon of End’s movement, and suddenly, he remembered an artifact.
A crown came out of his storage space.
[Crown of Eight Paths]
[Rank: S]
[An artifact created by the followers of the God of Chaos]
He had already read its description.
The requirement for using it was at least three thousand Spirit attributes, and he now had 4,000 Spirit attributes.
But the more important power of the crown was something else.
The [Eightfold Seal] that created eight independent seals, and each one could suppress a target.
And when all eight seals were placed on one creature, the restraining power increased greatly.
Of course, even this artifact could not imprison a Demon at the peak of its power for a long time.
But the description of the crown had pointed to something important, fixed anchors and prepared arrays could greatly increase the power of the seal.

He looked around at the huge pillars of the prison, there were many arrays, different seals, and various mechanisms here, and if this place was not suitable for something like this, there was nowhere else that could be.
He turned his head toward Seris.
"Keep the connection of the chain on the right active."
Seris nodded and, without asking why, immediately activated the Ancestral Mark and made the golden path connected to the anchor flow again.
Lian raised the crown, and mana flowed through it, eight seals separated from the surface of the crown and spread through the air one after another.
The first seal appeared on the free arm of the Demon of End.
Then the second.
The third.
The fourth.
The dragon noticed their presence.
"What is this—"
The fifth seal formed.
The sixth.
The seventh.
And finally, the eighth seal.
All eight seals were placed on one point of the dragon’s arm.
Their lines connected to each other, and a huge structure of ancient symbols formed around the arm.
The young Vorhelm transferred the restraining pressure to the anchors that Seris was keeping active. Golden light passed through the crown’s seals.
And then... BOOOOOOOM!
The Demon of End’s arm stopped in the middle of its movement, and for a moment, the entire prison became silent.
Even the dragon itself had not expected it.
It pulled its arm back angrily, and the eight seals shook, but they did not break, the ancient chains took part of the pressure.
Lian felt something extremely heavy being placed directly on his soul.
The pain started behind his eyes and then spread through his entire head, as if a creature with an impossible weight was trying to pass through his mind.
The difference in power was far too great, even with the eight seals and the prison’s help, he could not hold it for more than a few seconds.
But these few seconds were enough.
"Seris! Now!"
The girl placed her hand on the main path without any hesitation.
The Ancestral Mark lit up strongly, and golden threads rose through the pillars and moved toward the broken connection point.
At the same time, Lian used the last prepared reserve of Eclipse energy to target the remaining silver threads.
TSSSSSS!
The corruption collapsed, and the real command of the seal appeared again.
Seris activated it, and golden light flowed along the chain.
The separated ring returned toward the connection point under the pressure of the old arrays, and huge mana threads connected the two damaged sections again.
The chain was pulled, and the Demon of End’s arm moved several meters backward.
The dragon let out a terrifying roar.
KRAACK!
One of the eight crown seals broke under the pressure of that roar!

sentences.text: "Eclipse...?"
Lian raised his head, the Demon of End had stopped the movement of its claw.
Its huge red eye was no longer focused on Seris, it was not even looking at the newly repaired chains.
All of its attention was on the black and white lines moving through the golden light of the prison.
For a few seconds, it did nothing.
Then it pushed its neck forward as far as the chains allowed.
"This..."
Unlike before, there was no anger in the dragon’s voice, instead, there was something close to disbelief in it.
"Is this Eclipse energy?"
The young Vorhelm did not lower his hand.
There were still several corrupted threads left, and he had to destroy them.
"How?!" the Demon of End said louder this time.
Its huge head moved forward, and the chains around its neck were pulled with a terrifying sound.
"How can a human use Eclipse energy?!"
Lian gave it a short look.
Even the Silver Elf stopped controlling the corruption for a moment and looked more carefully at the corrupted light.
Apparently, neither of them had expected to see something like this.
But the dragon’s reaction was different, to it, this was not just some unknown energy, it knew it, and it knew it very well.
"That power belongs to a Demon!"
This time, its voice shook the entire prison.
"Impossible!
Where did you get it?!"
Lian sent one of the Eclipse threads toward another center of corruption.
Tess!
The center collapsed, and then he calmly said.
"I don’t think now is a good time for questions and answers."
The Demon of End stayed silent for a few moments, and then anger returned to its huge face.
"Arrogant human..."
He gave a faint smile, but something else was going through his mind, so the Demon of End knew the original owner of Eclipse energy.
But that was not strange either, and it was something he could easily guess, he was more curious about how well these two knew each other.
And more importantly, how a Demon would react to a human who could use the power of Demons.
The Silver Elf moved again, this time, there was no smile on her face.
"Enough."
The corruption spread at a much faster speed.
The threads that Lian had not yet had the chance to destroy suddenly separated from the secondary paths and moved toward one of the main chains.
Lian saw the change, all the energy gathered in the corrupted sections was being moved to one point.
The chain connected to the free arm of the Demon of End, the elf wanted to give the dragon more freedom of movement by destroying that chain.
"Seris!
The left arm’s chain!"
The girl moved at that exact moment, but the distance was too great, and before she reached it, the corruption rewrote the main command of the chain.
The golden light at the connection point went out, and a loud sound came from the huge metal.
KRRRRRAAAAAACK!
One of the main rings broke away from its anchor.
The chain moved freely through the air for a moment, and then struck one of the pillars with great force.
The upper part of the pillar broke, and the Demon of End let out a victorious roar.
Its arm was freer, and now it could move it much farther than before, and this was very bad news.
Its huge head also rose several dozen meters, and the pressure of its presence increased.
One unconsciously took several steps backward, and Two let out a short roar.
Lian immediately understood that the situation had changed.
If the dragon’s arm reached the platform again, there would be nothing left of the center of the seal for them to repair.
The Demon of End opened its mouth, and red energy gathered inside it, its target was Seris.
The girl was standing right beside the broken connection point.
Lian did not even wait for the attack to fully form, and gray lightning flared around his legs.
He reached her in one movement.
He put his arm around the girl’s waist, and before the red wave was fully released, he moved both of them away from the area.
BOOOOOOM!
The dragon’s attack passed beside them, and the pressure wave hit the plates of his armor, breaking part of his shoulder armor, and a sharp pain moved up to his neck.
He landed on a lower platform with his teeth clenched.
The young Pendragon immediately moved away from him, and her eyes stayed on Lian’s injured arm.
"Your arm."
He closed his fingers once, it hurt, a lot, but he could still make a fist.
"It works."
The girl said nothing, and Lian turned his eyes back toward the broken chain, he could no longer solve the problem with only speed and physical strength.
"What should we do now?" she also frowned.
He needed something that could restrain the Demon of End’s movement, and suddenly, he remembered an artifact.
A crown came out of his storage space.
[Crown of Eight Paths]
[Rank: S]
[An artifact created by the followers of the God of Chaos]
He had already read its description.
The requirement for using it was at least three thousand Spirit attributes, and he now had 4,000 Spirit attributes.
But the more important power of the crown was something else.
The [Eightfold Seal] that created eight independent seals, and each one could suppress a target.
And when all eight seals were placed on one creature, the restraining power increased greatly.
Of course, even this artifact could not imprison a Demon at the peak of its power for a long time.
But the description of the crown had pointed to something important, fixed anchors and prepared arrays could greatly increase the power of the seal.

He looked around at the huge pillars of the prison, there were many arrays, different seals, and various mechanisms here, and if this place was not suitable for something like this, there was nowhere else that could be.
He turned his head toward Seris.
"Keep the connection of the chain on the right active."
Seris nodded and, without asking why, immediately activated the Ancestral Mark and made the golden path connected to the anchor flow again.
Lian raised the crown, and mana flowed through it, eight seals separated from the surface of the crown and spread through the air one after another.
The first seal appeared on the free arm of the Demon of End.
Then the second.
The third.
The fourth.
The dragon noticed their presence.
"What is this—"
The fifth seal formed.
The sixth.
The seventh.
And finally, the eighth seal.
All eight seals were placed on one point of the dragon’s arm.
Their lines connected to each other, and a huge structure of ancient symbols formed around the arm.
The young Vorhelm transferred the restraining pressure to the anchors that Seris was keeping active.
Golden light passed through the crown’s seals.
And then...
BOOOOOOOM!
The Demon of End’s arm stopped in the middle of its movement, and for a moment, the entire prison became silent.
Even the dragon itself had not expected it.
It pulled its arm back angrily, and the eight seals shook, but they did not break, the ancient chains took part of the pressure.
Lian felt something extremely heavy being placed directly on his soul.
The pain started behind his eyes and then spread through his entire head, as if a creature with an impossible weight was trying to pass through his mind.
The difference in power was far too great, even with the eight seals and the prison’s help, he could not hold it for more than a few seconds.
But these few seconds were enough.
"Seris!
Now!"
The girl placed her hand on the main path without any hesitation.
The Ancestral Mark lit up strongly, and golden threads rose through the pillars and moved toward the broken connection point.
At the same time, Lian used the last prepared reserve of Eclipse energy to target the remaining silver threads.
TSSSSSS!
The corruption collapsed, and the real command of the seal appeared again.
Seris activated it, and golden light flowed along the chain.
The separated ring returned toward the connection point under the pressure of the old arrays, and huge mana threads connected the two damaged sections again.
The chain was pulled, and the Demon of End’s arm moved several meters backward.
The dragon let out a terrifying roar.
KRAACK!
One of the eight crown seals broke under the pressure of that roar!

chapters.title: Chapter 569: The Demon Finally Realized ( PS Bonus - )
paragraphs: Then the second seal of the crown also broke.
Lian felt something tearing inside his mind.
He forcibly cut the connection, and the remaining seals separated from the dragon’s arm, and the crown returned to his possession.
He put one knee on the ground.
His breathing was heavy.
For a few moments, he could not even see the scene in front of him clearly.
But the chain had been restored again, and the Demon of End could no longer move its arm as far as it could a few seconds ago.
He wiped the blood under his nose with the back of his hand, they had succeeded, not in defeating the Demon, they were not even close to that.
They had only managed to take away part of the freedom it had just gained again.
But even that was not a small result against such a creature.
Seris landed beside him.
The Ancestral Mark on her hand had become hot, and a red mark could be seen around the golden lines.
Her fingers trembled for a moment.
The young Vorhelm noticed it, it was not only him who was under great pressure, everything they were doing was putting direct pressure on their souls apart from the physical pressure.
"Can you still continue?"
She nodded, but this time she did not move immediately, she took a few calm breaths and closed her hand once.
Then she raised her sword.
The Moon Manifestation behind her was almost complete, and there was not much time left before her stats received a temporary 100% increase.
Lian focused his eyes on the distance, one main corrupted ring was still left, a ring through which an important part of the commands of the prison’s core was passing.

If they could cleanse it, the silver corruption would lose a large part of its power and everything would return under control and then they would have the chance to directly deal with the Silver Elf.
He looked at the girl.
"Seris, one more time."
Seris nodded, she did not ask any questions and had no hesitation, she only held her sword more tightly.
Through the Colony Link, Lian ordered One and Two to remain on the two sides of the remaining path.
Two activated one of his Disasters and disrupted the movement path of the dragon’s head for a moment.
Despite his injuries, One moved beside the healthy part of the platform so that if the claw came down again, he could use the remaining strength in his body to slightly change the path of the attack.
The Demon of End was still angry, but the restored chains had limited its movement more.
The young Vorhelm used that opportunity.
[Myriad Presence Mirage] activated again.
Five fake presences appeared in different parts of the battlefield.
The dragon quickly understood that they were not real, but while moving its head and claw and following Lian, it was forced to divide its attention for a moment.
At that moment, Lian used [Ashen Thunder Step] to reach the corrupted ring and [True Trail] revealed the real path of the corruption.
The silver network was still connected to the ring from several points, and his remaining Eclipse energy was no longer large.
So this time, he could not corrupt all the paths of light like before.
He could only destroy one corruption center, and because of that, he chose the most important remaining corruption center.
Then he turned his head toward the young Pendragon.
"The same point I showed you."
Seris raised her sword, the moon behind her became complete, and for a moment, a huge silver moon formed above the platform.
All the scattered lights around her turned toward it, and mana gathered on the blade of her sword.
[Full Moon Rend]
She moved her sword, and a huge slash of silver light moved along the marked path.
Not toward the main chain but directly toward the corrupted layer that had formed over the golden structure.
KRRRRRAAAAAASH!
The defense of the corruption center was split open, and the threads around it separated from each other for a moment.
Lian reached out his right hand, the last thread of Eclipse energy passed through the opening.
It reached the center of the corruption.
TSSSSSS!
Blackness spread from the center of the node, and the silver structure collapsed within a few moments.
Seris immediately activated the Ancestral Mark, and golden light flowed through the entire ring.
The real commands of the seal arrays returned to their true paths one after another, and the huge ring lit up at full power for the first time since they entered.
The chains connected to it were pulled, and the neck of the Demon of End moved several meters lower, its free arm was also pulled back into a smaller range.
The sea of red mist became calm for a moment, and even the sound of the chains became quieter.
Lian stood on the damaged platform and took a deep breath, his armor had many cracks, and his right arm hurt.
His soul was still extremely tired from the pressure of the Crown of Eight Paths but, they had done it, an important part of the seal had been restored.
He turned his eyes toward the Silver Elf, the creature was no longer smiling, the corruption had not been completely destroyed, but several of its main paths had been destroyed.
Even if she intended to continue the operation, it was no longer as easy as before.
And right at that moment, something moved inside Lian’s body.
Thump.
He held his breath for a moment, this heartbeat was not coming from the Eclipse Core, he immediately understood the difference.
The thing that had now moved was deeper.
In a space that even the System could not properly identify, something had made a sound.
Ruined Heart.
For a moment, he felt that familiar heavy feeling inside his chest.
It was more like the heartbeat of an existence that had been completely silent until a few seconds ago.
Thump!
This time, it was even heavier than before.
He lowered his eyes, what had happened?
No System message appeared, and no new ability activated, only that heartbeat had suddenly appeared from nowhere.
Why had the heart suddenly reacted? Had it sensed something?
And farther away, the Demon of End suddenly became still, the dragon’s huge eye fixed on Lian.
Until a few seconds ago, its only goal had been to become free, it had angrily pulled the chains, attacked Seris, and asked the Silver Elf to continue the release operation.
But now it was not looking at any of them.
Even the chains that had been pulled around its body again no longer caught its attention.
Its entire existence was focused on Lian.
The sudden silence of a creature of that size, after all the previous roars and explosions, was stranger than the battle itself.
The Pendragon noticed the change and for some reason, she felt an ominous feeling and raised her sword.
Lian had still not moved, he was also looking at the dragon, something in that creature’s eyes had changed.
It was no longer only anger, disbelief? No.
Something deeper, something much deeper.
It was as if the Demon of End had seen something that it had never expected to see, something it believed was impossible to see.
The silence continued for a few seconds.
Then a huge voice spread throughout the entire prison.
"I understand!"
The young Vorhelm frowned, and Seris moved one step closer to him.
The Silver Elf also turned her head toward the Demon, the dragon pushed its huge neck forward as far as the chains allowed.
Its red eyes were fixed on Lian.
This time, its voice was strange, almost a whisper, but even the whisper of a creature of that size could be heard throughout the entire prison.
"No... impossible..."
He said nothing, he did not even know what the Demon was talking about.
Eclipse energy? No.
It had already seen it, it had already asked about it, so what was causing this reaction now? It was not difficult to understand... the thing that had suddenly reacted a few moments ago.
The Demon of End took a heavy breath and then slammed its entire body against the chains.
GRRRRRRRRRR!
The sound of huge metal being pulled spread through the prison, and several golden rings shook.
Seris immediately prepared to activate the Mark again, but Lian raised his left hand slightly.
"Wait."
He wanted to understand what had happened.
The Demon of End pulled its body again, this time with much more anger than during the entire previous battle.
"Impossible!"
Its roar came from between its huge teeth.
"This cannot... this cannot be possible!"
The Silver Elf, who had remained silent until then, lost control of her voice, even she was frightened when she saw the dragon’s sudden behavior.
"Calm down!"
The Demon did not even look at her and pulled the chains again, one of the distant pillars shook under the pressure.
This time, the elf shouted in a sharper voice.
"You are ruining everything! The seals have become stable again! If you keep putting pressure on them like this, you will destroy our own paths!"
But the Demon of End did not care at all, apparently, becoming free was no longer the only thing occupying its mind.
Its huge eyes remained fixed on Lian, its heavy breaths moved the sea of red mist.
Its teeth hit each other with a terrifying sound.
Seris stood beside the young Vorhelm, her sword was ready, but she had also realized that the situation had changed.
The Demon of End no longer behaved like a creature that only wanted to escape the prison.
It was more like a creature that had remembered a terrifying truth.
Or something it had been afraid of had appeared in front of it again.
The dragon opened its mouth, and for a moment, the words got stuck in its throat.
Lian did not take his eyes off it, the Ruined Heart inside his chest beat again.
Thump!
The Demon suddenly raised its head higher, its eyes shining with disbelief and madness, and then it shouted with a voice that shook the entire prison.
"You... you have the Heart!"

chapters.title: Chapter 570: One Last Option
paragraphs: "...You have the Heart!"
The Demon of End’s roar continued to echo through the enormous prison.
Lian stood on the black platform, keeping his eyes on the red eyes of the enormous creature in front of him.
A few moments ago, the dragon had still been trying to break its chains and escape from the prison where it had been trapped for centuries.
But now? It was no longer even looking at the chains.
All its attention was focused on him, as if its own freedom meant nothing compared to what it had just discovered.
"That Heart..." The dragon’s voice was lower this time, but there was a strange tremble in it. "That Heart should have been destroyed. There shouldn’t be any trace of it left!"
Lian slightly furrowed his brows.
The Ruined Heart.
Ever since that broken black heart had appeared inside his body, he had had many questions about it.
Even the System couldn’t identify it, and every time he had tried to understand its true nature, he had only received incomplete information.
Now, a creature at the Demon rank had not only recognized it, but its reaction looked more like fear than curiosity.
"What do you know about the Heart?"
The enormous eyes of the Demon of End narrowed, and for a moment, anger replaced its disbelief.
"You don’t even know what you’re carrying?"
A harsh laugh came from between its enormous teeth, but it sounded more nervous and disturbed than amused.
"Idiot! That thing must not exist! No one should ever allow it to exist again!"
The young Vorhelm kept his eyes on the dragon’s face, and one thing caught his attention more than anything else.
The Demon showed no interest in taking the Heart for itself.
It didn’t want to pull it out of his body, nor did it try to negotiate with him about how he had obtained it.
It only wanted to destroy it, and a creature that was willing to risk its chance at freedom just to destroy something probably had a very good reason.
Seris took a step and stood beside Lian.
Her sword was still in her right hand, and a faint silver light moved around its blade. The Ancestral Mark on the back of her hand was also still shining, despite the pressure of the previous battle.
The Demon of End noticed the girl’s movement.
"Move aside, Pendragon!"
Seris showed no change in her expression.
"No."
Those two words were enough to make the Demon let out a terrifying roar of anger as it raised its half-freed arm.
But this time, Lian immediately noticed something different about the attack. The space around its claw had started to change.
The distance between the claw and the platform itself became unstable for a moment.
Predator’s Instincts sent him a warning.
"Seris, move back!"
They both moved at almost the same time.
The enormous claw passed far away from where they had been standing, but what it left behind was much worse than an ordinary shockwave.
A black line appeared in space.

For a moment, it was as if the two sides of that line were no longer connected. Part of the stone platform split in half without the claw even touching it, and after a short delay, its upper half fell into the sea of red mist.
He landed on one of the intact parts of the platform, his eyes narrowing slightly.
This was no longer ordinary destructive power, the Demon of End was using something that was probably the main reason for its title.
The Essence of the End.
A power that could bring an end to any structure, existence, or concept, even if that structure was part of the surrounding space.
Of course, the dragon was still inside the prison, the enormous golden spike was still piercing its chest, and most of the ancient chains were preventing it from releasing its full power.
But even this limited amount of power was dangerous.
If that tear had passed directly through Lian’s body, even the World-Devourer Bastion would probably not have been able to stop it like an ordinary physical attack.
"Kill him!"
The Demon of End’s roar shook the prison once again.
He turned his eyes toward it.
"I think you should decide whether you want to get free or kill me first."
But contrary to his expectations, this taunt only made the creature even angrier.
"Freedom?!"
The dragon pulled at the chains around its neck with all its strength.
Grrrrrrrr!
The golden light on several rings shook violently.
"If that Heart has truly returned, what does my freedom even matter?!"

The young Vorhelm remained silent for a moment, this sentence was stranger than all its previous threats, but before he could ask another question, the Silver Elf’s voice came from near the heart of the seal.
"Enough!"
The silver creature stood between the golden rings. Her clone had become somewhat unstable, but she was still connected to the prison’s network.
"If you keep going like this, you’ll destroy the chains along with our own paths! We didn’t work this hard to free you just so you could ruin everything yourself!"
The Demon didn’t even look at her.
"That human must die."
The Elf remained silent for a moment, then her gaze moved between Lian, Seris, and the newly repaired chains.
She seemed to have reached a decision. If she couldn’t calm the Demon of End, she would have to bring the plan to an end faster.
Even if doing so increased the risk of destroying the entire prison structure.
She hadn’t wanted to go this far. Her original goal was to secretly free the Demon and then erase all evidence of her presence here before disappearing.

That way, the human world, which had been divided into several parts because of the accusations the powerful forces had made against one another, would also have a monster at the Demon rank causing destruction everywhere.
But with things like this, it seemed she had no choice but to use her last option.
"Fine."
The Elf raised her hand.
"Then there’s no reason to preserve the remaining seals anymore."
Lian felt the flow of mana change at that very moment. At the center of the prison’s core, the small silver seed from which all the corruption had started began to spin.
[Silver Corruption Seed]
[Rank: S]
[A special artifact created by the Silver Elves. It can corrupt and disable various formations and reverse the original commands of mechanisms.]
The silver threads spread throughout the chains and pillars began to return all at once, instead of redirecting energy through different paths as they had before.
At first, he thought the Elf was trying to retreat.
But [True Sequence] quickly revealed something else.
The threads were gathering the corrupted energy, all the energy that had been stolen from the defensive network and the Dragon Marks over the past several hours was now returning to a single point.
Her goal was to release all of it at once.
Lian lowered his gaze toward the golden paths beneath his feet.
If all that energy was released at the center of the network, the original commands of the seal would be reversed for a moment.
That meant the chains that were supposed to be strengthened by the energy would begin to lose their power instead, and the entire prison could collapse from the inside.
"Seris!"
The girl looked at him immediately.
"The root! She’s attacking the root directly!"
Seris raised her right hand, and her Ancestral Mark shone, but before she could access the main flow of energy, the Silver Corruption Seed released its final command.
BOOM!
A heavy sound rose from the depths of the prison, and the golden light of several pillars went out at the same time.
The enormous chain restraining the Demon of End’s neck loosened for a moment, and part of the dragon’s body moved upward under the pressure.
The red mist at the bottom of the prison moved aside in a massive wave.
The Demon of End roared.
This time, its roar was not caused by anger alone, it had sensed that the prison was weakening and that it had gained a new chance to move.
At that moment, a blue window appeared in front of Lian.
[Emergency Quest]
[Prevent the release of the Demon of End.]
[Failure Consequence: Possible destruction of a large part of the European continent.]
[Objective: Prevent the seal from collapsing and return the Demon of End to its restrained state.]
[Success Rewards: Level up by 2, 200 Fragments, 200 Stat Points.]

Seris was also looking at a window in front of her, apparently, she had received the same quest.
He slowly let out a breath.
"Well, it seems all our efforts were useless."
The young Pendragon gave him a brief glance but said nothing, instead, she immediately turned her attention back to her Ancestral Mark.
Because something inside it had changed. Golden lines from the Mark shone across the back of her hand and reached almost to her wrist.
This time, instead of the usual pain, a network of paths appeared in her perception.
Thousands of paths, each connected to one of the active Dragon Marks of the Pendragon Family.
Some were inside Verendal, while others were much farther away, but they all led back to the same root, and that root was now collapsing.
To put it simply, everything the Silver Elf was doing directly targeted the core of the sealing formation, and she wanted to destroy it directly.
Her original plan had been to slowly disable the chains first and then go after the core of the sealing formation, but it seemed she had decided to take the noisier approach now.
Seris remained motionless for a few moments.
Lian noticed the change in her expression.
"What did you see?"
The girl didn’t answer. Her gaze remained fixed on the Mark, and then she spoke in a quiet voice.
"There is a way."
"To stop her?"
She nodded, but something in her eyes made him guess the next part before he even asked.
There was a cost, and it probably wasn’t small.
The young Pendragon lowered her hand slightly.
"The Marks."
Lian furrowed his brows.
"What?"
"They all have to be returned."
It took him a few seconds to understand what she meant.
All the Dragon Marks received by the younger generation of the Pendragon Family were stored and connected to the main root, and they served as a source of energy for the seal.

But they shouldn’t forget that the formation had also spent a great deal of energy to create them. To some extent, it was an investment, a large amount of energy was spent to create those Marks, and the Pendragons who possessed them returned that energy over the years, along with its benefits.
So if all the Marks were destroyed, a large amount of energy would return to the formation.
If their energy returned to the center of the prison, it might be enough to fight against the Silver Corruption Seed.
But what would happen afterward?
"Does that mean all of them will be destroyed?" He doubted the Pendragons would be happy about that.

sentences.text: "...You have the Heart!"
The Demon of End’s roar continued to echo through the enormous prison.
Lian stood on the black platform, keeping his eyes on the red eyes of the enormous creature in front of him.
A few moments ago, the dragon had still been trying to break its chains and escape from the prison where it had been trapped for centuries.
But now?
It was no longer even looking at the chains.
All its attention was focused on him, as if its own freedom meant nothing compared to what it had just discovered.
"That Heart..." The dragon’s voice was lower this time, but there was a strange tremble in it.
"That Heart should have been destroyed.
There shouldn’t be any trace of it left!"
Lian slightly furrowed his brows.
The Ruined Heart.
Ever since that broken black heart had appeared inside his body, he had had many questions about it.
Even the System couldn’t identify it, and every time he had tried to understand its true nature, he had only received incomplete information.
Now, a creature at the Demon rank had not only recognized it, but its reaction looked more like fear than curiosity.
"What do you know about the Heart?"
The enormous eyes of the Demon of End narrowed, and for a moment, anger replaced its disbelief.
"You don’t even know what you’re carrying?"
A harsh laugh came from between its enormous teeth, but it sounded more nervous and disturbed than amused.
"Idiot!
That thing must not exist!
No one should ever allow it to exist again!"
The young Vorhelm kept his eyes on the dragon’s face, and one thing caught his attention more than anything else.
The Demon showed no interest in taking the Heart for itself.
It didn’t want to pull it out of his body, nor did it try to negotiate with him about how he had obtained it.
It only wanted to destroy it, and a creature that was willing to risk its chance at freedom just to destroy something probably had a very good reason.
Seris took a step and stood beside Lian.
Her sword was still in her right hand, and a faint silver light moved around its blade.
The Ancestral Mark on the back of her hand was also still shining, despite the pressure of the previous battle.
The Demon of End noticed the girl’s movement.
"Move aside, Pendragon!"
Seris showed no change in her expression.
"No."
Those two words were enough to make the Demon let out a terrifying roar of anger as it raised its half-freed arm.
But this time, Lian immediately noticed something different about the attack.
The space around its claw had started to change.
The distance between the claw and the platform itself became unstable for a moment.
Predator’s Instincts sent him a warning.
"Seris, move back!"
They both moved at almost the same time.
The enormous claw passed far away from where they had been standing, but what it left behind was much worse than an ordinary shockwave.
A black line appeared in space.
For a moment, it was as if the two sides of that line were no longer connected.
Part of the stone platform split in half without the claw even touching it, and after a short delay, its upper half fell into the sea of red mist.
He landed on one of the intact parts of the platform, his eyes narrowing slightly.
This was no longer ordinary destructive power, the Demon of End was using something that was probably the main reason for its title.
The Essence of the End.
A power that could bring an end to any structure, existence, or concept, even if that structure was part of the surrounding space.
Of course, the dragon was still inside the prison, the enormous golden spike was still piercing its chest, and most of the ancient chains were preventing it from releasing its full power.
But even this limited amount of power was dangerous.
If that tear had passed directly through Lian’s body, even the World-Devourer Bastion would probably not have been able to stop it like an ordinary physical attack.
"Kill him!"
The Demon of End’s roar shook the prison once again.
He turned his eyes toward it.
"I think you should decide whether you want to get free or kill me first."
But contrary to his expectations, this taunt only made the creature even angrier.
"Freedom?!"
The dragon pulled at the chains around its neck with all its strength.
Grrrrrrrr!
The golden light on several rings shook violently.
"If that Heart has truly returned, what does my freedom even matter?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 571: You Need a Dragon Mark
paragraphs: Seris nodded.
Lian kept his eyes on her face.
The issue was not just losing a single Mark.
The Dragon Mark was considered one of the most important legacies of the Pendragon Family, and many members of the younger generation had spent years trying to obtain one.
Some planned to use it during their third evolution to form a Dragon Body.
Others had built their entire growth paths around this blessing.
And now, all those Marks were going to disappear.
He looked at the Mark on the girl’s hand, she had only received the sixth-grade Ancestral Mark that very morning.
The highest possible Mark.
But now, she had to make a decision that most members of her family would probably find difficult to forgive, even after hearing her reasons.
Seris looked at the golden lines for a few seconds, then raised her hand.
"I’ll do it."
Lian didn’t smile and only asked,
"Are you sure?"
"There is no other choice."
She was right.
If the Demon of End was released, it would no longer matter how many people had Dragon Marks.
But there was still another problem, and he used [True Sequence] to examine the flows coming from the root.
The golden paths could be controlled by her Ancestral Mark, but the part of the network that was in direct contact with the Demon of End’s energy was far too dangerous for an ordinary human.
The young Pendragon couldn’t control both parts at the same time, and at that moment, the Eclipse Core inside Lian’s body reacted.
Thump!
Lian lowered his gaze, so once again, they would have to divide their roles.
"You take control of the main path, I’ll hold back the corrupted part."
The girl looked at him for a few seconds before nodding.
The dragon raised its claw again.
"Begin."
Beyond the gap, the golden rings were rotating in different directions, and the silver threads of corruption were still flowing back toward the seed.
Worse still, the Demon of End’s half-freed claw could attack a large part of these paths.
But Seris didn’t hesitate for even a moment, and Lian gave her a brief glance.
"I’ll open the way, just reach the heart of the formation." To carry out their plan, they had to reach it.
She nodded, and they both moved.
[Predator’s Instincts] was still active, and Lian detected the path of the Demon’s claw before it had fully moved.
"Right!"
The young Pendragon immediately changed direction, and the enormous claw came down from above their path, crushing part of the stone behind them.
BOOOOM!
Pieces of stone scattered through the air.
He used [Ashen Thunder Step] to move through the rubble and reach the edge of the gap.
She landed a few meters behind him, the path they needed to cross no longer existed.
Lian lowered his hand, and [Frost Dominion] responded to his command.
Thick ice extended from the edge of the platform, creating a narrow path toward the central ring, but before it was complete, another wave of pressure from the Demon struck it.
The middle section of the ice bridge cracked.
He gritted his teeth.
"Seris, go!"
The girl moved along the path without asking any questions.
At the same time, the young Vorhelm struck a fallen piece of stone with [Glacial Reaper Claw] and his armored fist, changing the direction of the falling debris.
The enormous stone passed beside the bridge.
Seris jumped from the end of the path and landed on the outer ring of the formation’s core, and Lian followed her with [Ashen Thunder Step].
Now they were both standing directly in front of the central core, and the scale of the formation was even stranger up close.
Golden rings rotated over one another in several directions, and a floating black crystal sat at their center, with thousands of thin golden threads extending from its surface.
Each thread was connected to a part of the prison, every chain, every pillar, and every anchor, this formation was even connected to the artifact responsible for creating the Dragon Marks.
And now, the foreign silver threads had worked their way into these same paths.
Seris took a deep breath, then placed the hand bearing her Ancestral Mark against the surface of the central crystal.
At the moment of contact, all the rings around them stopped for one second.
Then golden light spread from beneath her hand, and thousands of ancient symbols appeared on the crystal, rotating around her hand like rings of writing.
Lian realized that the formation was identifying the Ancestral Mark.
Not just as a sixth-grade Mark, but as the closest and most powerful active connection to the main root, in other words, this Mark was the formation’s most important source and anchor.
The formation viewed the owners of the Marks as anchors, and the bearer of the Ancestral Mark was its most important anchor.
The young Pendragon closed her eyes for a moment, and information about the formation’s structure entered her mind.
But unlike the usual System messages, this was not ready-made information, it was more like a set of commands designed to control the seal network.
"Found it." Then she spoke softly.
"What do you need?" Lian stood beside her.
"Time."
He turned his gaze toward the Demon of End, the dragon had raised its claw again.
"How much?"
"I don’t know."
"Fine, take as much as you need."
And he moved in front of her.
Seris activated the formation’s emergency command with her Ancestral Mark, and at that moment, the enormous seal network began to change.
The outer rings slowed down, and the paths that had previously sent energy from the center to different parts of the network began changing direction one after another.
Lian could see these changes from the corner of his eye, but all his attention was on the Demon of End, the dragon had realized that they had reached the heart of the formation.
And it had no intention of letting them finish their work.
"No!"
Its enormous arm came forward.
The young Vorhelm moved away with [Ashen Thunder Step].
The claw struck the outer part of the ring.
CRAAAAASH!

Part of the formation’s stone protection shattered, but the main golden ring withstood the blow, the rings were part of the seal and formation structure, and they had been made strong enough to withstand attacks from monsters.
Lian used that opportunity to reach a damaged spot on one of the dragon’s fingers.
His right fist struck the cracked scale with the power of [Glacial Reaper Claw].
BOOOOM!
A thick layer of ice spread over the crack, and the Demon shook its finger in great anger, breaking part of the ice, but its claw had slowed down for a moment.
He moved back, and at the same time, Seris still hadn’t removed her hand from the heart of the formation.
Her expression remained cold, but the muscles in her right arm had become extremely tense, she was no longer controlling just one path of the seal.
The entire network of active Pendragon Marks was now within her perception.
And she had to return all of them to the center.
She opened her eyes, looked at the thousands of golden paths for a moment, and then carried out the final command.
Across the world, the active Dragon Marks of the Pendragon Family began to shine.
Lucien Pendragon was standing in one of the palace corridors when the Ruler’s Mark on his hand suddenly lit up.
He instinctively raised his hand, but before he could understand what had changed, golden lines separated from his skin like particles of light, and then the Mark disappeared.
In other parts of the city, Kaelen and Lysandra experienced the same thing, along with Tristan and the other young people who had received their Marks that morning.
Even members of the family who were in other cities around the world and had not yet used their Dragon Marks to form a [Dragon Body] experienced the same thing.
All the active Marks disappeared one after another.
None of them knew why, but inside the prison, thousands of golden threads returned from deep within the network toward the central formation.
Lian briefly turned his head.
Golden lights passed through the enormous rings and reached the black crystal at the center.
Seris took a deep breath.
The pressure of transferring this amount of energy was enormous, but her Ancestral Mark continued to shine.
She pressed her hand more firmly against the heart of the formation, and the last golden path arrived, and then... BOOOOM!
All the rings of the seal’s core lit up at the same time, and the reversed flow created by the Silver Corruption Seed stopped for a moment.
The energy from the returned Marks reached the main chains, and the golden light on the prison pillars grew brighter again.
Several chains that had been loose moments ago tightened with a tremendous sound.
The young Pendragon forcefully let out her breath, her hand still resting on the central crystal.
Lian turned his gaze away from the Demon of End and looked at her.
"Is it over?"
Seris looked at the golden flow for a moment, then slowly nodded.
"The corruption has been pushed back."
He let out a short breath, it seemed they had truly managed to stop the Silver Elf’s final attack.
But at that exact moment, something changed in the formation’s structure.
Golden light flowed through the rings at full power for several seconds... then one of the outer rings shook.
Then a second one.
At first, Lian thought the Silver Corruption Seed had become active again, but when he focused [True Sequence] on the structure, he realized the problem was coming from somewhere else.
The corruption had been pushed back.
The original commands were flowing in the correct directions again.
But something was missing.
Before this, hundreds of active Dragon Marks in different parts of the world had been connected to the central network.
They didn’t just use the formation’s energy, each of them also provided part of the formation’s energy supply, it was a mutual relationship, not a one-way one.
Now, all those Marks had disappeared.

The original energy that had been used to create the Marks had returned to the formations and the seal structure, but that was all... the extra energy that the Mark bearers had been providing to the seal was no longer there.
The heart of the formation had been strengthened for a moment by the returned energy, but without a stable source, this situation wouldn’t last.
The girl still had her hand on the crystal, she watched the changing flows for a few seconds, then spoke briefly.
"We have a problem, the formation needs another source of energy to keep working."
Lian immediately examined the structure again, and this time, he saw something that had been impossible to notice before the Marks’ energy returned.
Hundreds of empty paths surrounded the heart of the formation, each path was a place meant for a Dragon Mark.
The network’s commands were trying to activate those paths again, as if the formation wanted to divide the gathered energy among hundreds of parts and rebuild the previous connections.
But doing that would bring the situation back to where it had started.
The seal’s energy would be spread among hundreds of carriers.
The root would still depend on the same vulnerable connections, and if the Silver Corruption Seed got another chance, it could take advantage of them again.
He looked at the shaking rings, so completing the transfer didn’t mean their work was finished.
They had gathered enough energy to prevent the seal from collapsing immediately.
But to maintain it, they needed a new anchor that could provide the remaining energy required by the seal and the formations.
Lian looked at Seris’s Ancestral Mark for a moment, the girl still had her own Mark, but one person wasn’t enough.
They needed another source.
They couldn’t allow the formation’s energy reserves to be divided among hundreds of different paths again to create Dragon Marks for hundreds of people.
They needed someone who could produce as much energy for the formation as hundreds of people, a power source worth hundreds of sources to the formation.
Seris exchanged a glance with Lian and, after thinking for a moment, said,
"I guess you need to get a Dragon Mark."

Part of the formation’s stone protection shattered, but the main golden ring withstood the blow, the rings were part of the seal and formation structure, and they had been made strong enough to withstand attacks from monsters.
Lian used that opportunity to reach a damaged spot on one of the dragon’s fingers.
His right fist struck the cracked scale with the power of [Glacial Reaper Claw].
BOOOOM!
A thick layer of ice spread over the crack, and the Demon shook its finger in great anger, breaking part of the ice, but its claw had slowed down for a moment.
He moved back, and at the same time, Seris still hadn’t removed her hand from the heart of the formation.
Her expression remained cold, but the muscles in her right arm had become extremely tense, she was no longer controlling just one path of the seal.
The entire network of active Pendragon Marks was now within her perception.
And she had to return all of them to the center.
She opened her eyes, looked at the thousands of golden paths for a moment, and then carried out the final command.
Across the world, the active Dragon Marks of the Pendragon Family began to shine.
Lucien Pendragon was standing in one of the palace corridors when the Ruler’s Mark on his hand suddenly lit up.
He instinctively raised his hand, but before he could understand what had changed, golden lines separated from his skin like particles of light, and then the Mark disappeared.
In other parts of the city, Kaelen and Lysandra experienced the same thing, along with Tristan and the other young people who had received their Marks that morning.
Even members of the family who were in other cities around the world and had not yet used their Dragon Marks to form a [Dragon Body] experienced the same thing.
All the active Marks disappeared one after another.
None of them knew why, but inside the prison, thousands of golden threads returned from deep within the network toward the central formation.
Lian briefly turned his head.
Golden lights passed through the enormous rings and reached the black crystal at the center.
Seris took a deep breath.
The pressure of transferring this amount of energy was enormous, but her Ancestral Mark continued to shine.
She pressed her hand more firmly against the heart of the formation, and the last golden path arrived, and then...
BOOOOM!
All the rings of the seal’s core lit up at the same time, and the reversed flow created by the Silver Corruption Seed stopped for a moment.
The energy from the returned Marks reached the main chains, and the golden light on the prison pillars grew brighter again.
Several chains that had been loose moments ago tightened with a tremendous sound.
The young Pendragon forcefully let out her breath, her hand still resting on the central crystal.
Lian turned his gaze away from the Demon of End and looked at her.
"Is it over?"
Seris looked at the golden flow for a moment, then slowly nodded.
"The corruption has been pushed back."
He let out a short breath, it seemed they had truly managed to stop the Silver Elf’s final attack.
But at that exact moment, something changed in the formation’s structure.
Golden light flowed through the rings at full power for several seconds... then one of the outer rings shook.
Then a second one.
At first, Lian thought the Silver Corruption Seed had become active again, but when he focused [True Sequence] on the structure, he realized the problem was coming from somewhere else.
The corruption had been pushed back.
The original commands were flowing in the correct directions again.
But something was missing.
Before this, hundreds of active Dragon Marks in different parts of the world had been connected to the central network.
They didn’t just use the formation’s energy, each of them also provided part of the formation’s energy supply, it was a mutual relationship, not a one-way one.
Now, all those Marks had disappeared.

The original energy that had been used to create the Marks had returned to the formations and the seal structure, but that was all... the extra energy that the Mark bearers had been providing to the seal was no longer there.
The heart of the formation had been strengthened for a moment by the returned energy, but without a stable source, this situation wouldn’t last.
The girl still had her hand on the crystal, she watched the changing flows for a few seconds, then spoke briefly.
"We have a problem, the formation needs another source of energy to keep working."
Lian immediately examined the structure again, and this time, he saw something that had been impossible to notice before the Marks’ energy returned.
Hundreds of empty paths surrounded the heart of the formation, each path was a place meant for a Dragon Mark.
The network’s commands were trying to activate those paths again, as if the formation wanted to divide the gathered energy among hundreds of parts and rebuild the previous connections.
But doing that would bring the situation back to where it had started.
The seal’s energy would be spread among hundreds of carriers.
The root would still depend on the same vulnerable connections, and if the Silver Corruption Seed got another chance, it could take advantage of them again.
He looked at the shaking rings, so completing the transfer didn’t mean their work was finished.
They had gathered enough energy to prevent the seal from collapsing immediately.
But to maintain it, they needed a new anchor that could provide the remaining energy required by the seal and the formations.
Lian looked at Seris’s Ancestral Mark for a moment, the girl still had her own Mark, but one person wasn’t enough.
They needed another source.
They couldn’t allow the formation’s energy reserves to be divided among hundreds of different paths again to create Dragon Marks for hundreds of people.
They needed someone who could produce as much energy for the formation as hundreds of people, a power source worth hundreds of sources to the formation.
Seris exchanged a glance with Lian and, after thinking for a moment, said,
"I guess you need to get a Dragon Mark."

chapters.title: Chapter 572: The Pendragons Won’t Like This
paragraphs: "Excuse me?"
Lian stared at the core of the seal formation for several seconds.
The formation was so massive that the energy of an ordinary person could not even meet a small part of its needs.
In the past, hundreds of Dragon Marks had maintained this connection together.
Now, if all those paths were going to be replaced by a single anchor, that person needed to have the capacity to withstand and transfer power comparable to what hundreds of carriers could handle.
This did not necessarily mean having hundreds of times more mana than an ordinary human.
Instead, they needed to be able to maintain the pressure of hundreds of paths within a single structure, without allowing either their own body or the formation to collapse.

After Awakened reached their third evolution, their mana and energy underwent certain changes and no longer worked in the usual way, which was why they could not serve as energy sources for the formation.
On the other hand, the formation only needed someone to keep the energy flowing, while the seal structure itself could still produce and generate a large amount of energy, covering most of its needs.
Lian lowered his gaze.
The Eclipse Core inside his body was still rotating slowly.
After his body evolution, his body had become completely different in quality from that of an ordinary human.
However, even with all of this, there was no guarantee that he could withstand the pressure of such a formation.
On the other hand, what better option did they have?
The End Demon was still alive.

And every second the seal remained without an anchor, the risk of losing all the progress they had made increased, even if he could not make up for the difference between hundreds and thousands of people forever, he had to stabilize the formation for now.
He took a calm breath and then said,
"Seris, keep the paths stable."
The girl fixed her gaze on him.
"Where are you going?"
"I’ll become its second energy source."
She activated the Ancestral Mark more fully and kept the golden flows around the formation’s core stable, allowing Lian to reach the second section.
Lian passed by the first ring.

On the other side of the seal’s core, there was a narrow platform that had remained hidden beneath the formation’s intense light until now, several golden paths extended from the center to this platform, and all of them were now inactive.
The moment he stepped onto the platform, a heavy pressure fell upon his body.
It was not the pressure of the Demon’s presence, but the pressure of the formation itself.
The ancient structure was examining whatever was trying to enter its core.
Lian opened his right fist.
He sent his mana flowing along his arm, and a golden wall immediately formed in front of him.
Lian frowned.
The same problem again that he faced when he wanted to enter the prison, he was not a member of the Pendragon Family, and the formation had been designed to serve only the Pendragons.
But at that moment, Seris’s Mark shone from the other side of the seal.
One of the golden rings rotated, and the wall in front of Lian moved aside for a few seconds.
She nodded at him from a distance.
He also moved forward without wasting any time.
At the center of the second platform, there was a smooth black surface where hundreds of inactive golden strands gathered.
Lian knelt on one knee and placed his right hand on the surface, allowing his mana to enter the main path.
The moment he made contact, the formation’s core reacted, and hundreds of golden strands moved toward his hand.
The flow was so powerful that the muscles in his arm tightened for a moment.
The second flow entered.
Then the third.
Then the fourth.
He gritted his teeth, the pressure was not only affecting his mana, the formation was also testing the capacity of his body and soul.
If he could not withstand these flows, the connection would be cut off, and if he insisted too much, his soul and body might suffer serious damage.
However, contrary to his expectations, the flows did not stop after a few moments.
The Eclipse Core began to react, and the Ruined Heart also gave a weak beat deep inside him.
Thump!
Lian held his breath for a moment, as a new wave of pressure spread throughout his body.
The formation seemed to have detected something unusual in his structure.

His ordinary mana alone could not compare to that of thousands of Dragon Mark holders, but the presence of a Demon’s Core and the special structure of his body allowed him to pass much denser power through himself than an ordinary human could withstand.
And the Ruined Heart, without its nature being clear to either the System or Lian himself, was preventing this connection from collapsing and was helping him.
Instead of spreading out among hundreds of empty paths, the golden strands connected to a single point one after another.
Lian.
At this moment, he was not simply providing part of his own mana to the formation.

He was becoming a living anchor, a fixed point that could maintain the connection between the Root and the prison’s massive energy reserves, while also helping stabilize it over time with his own mana.
The main work still belonged to the formation’s energy reserves, but all those flows were now being organized through two sources, him and Seris.
And this was a burden that had once been divided among thousands of Marks, but now only two people had to bear it.
The young Vorhelm felt his right arm burning, the seal formation had accepted him, and now it was creating a Dragon Mark for him.
Golden lines spread from his wrist to his elbow.
His vision even blurred for a moment, but he did not remove his hand, while on the other side of the seal, Seris was keeping all the main flows stable.
She could see the change.
Hundreds of empty paths went dark one after another, and their energy was transferred to the new connection.
The central anchor was no longer trying to create new Marks scattered across different paths.
All the power that had previously been meant to be divided among thousands of carriers was now being concentrated into a single path.
Lian.
When the final flow reached his hand, the golden light grew much brighter.
The young Pendragon had to turn her face slightly away.
He felt something hot being engraved on the back of his hand.
First, two wings, then the head of a dragon, its long horns, and finally, a body surrounded by twisting lines.
The Mark was complete.
[ Dragon Mark acquired ]
[ Rank: Ancestral ]
[ Grade: 6 ]
Lian looked at the message for a few moments.
An Ancestral Mark?
The same grade Seris had?
But before he could think about it, another window appeared.
[ Exclusive Blessing of the Ancestral Mark has been formed ]
[ Wings of God ]
At that moment, the formation’s core began to operate with a deep sound, and all the golden rings that had been shaking just seconds ago returned to their previous rotation speed.
The accumulated energy from the sacrificed Marks remained within the seal’s main network instead of being redistributed.
Golden strands stretched from Lian’s hand to the formation’s core, and after the Mark was stabilized, they sank into the seal structure.
The immense pressure on his body decreased, but it did not disappear completely.
Lian could still feel the new connection.
He knew that from this moment on, part of the prison’s stability would depend on his new Mark, as well as Seris’s, but this was only temporary.

They could not provide enough energy for such a massive structure on their own, and sooner or later, more precisely, when everything was over and the dragon returned to its sleep, they would have to find a way to supply energy to the formation.
Fortunately, that would no longer be their problem, the Pendragon Family could find a way to handle it.
However, he was also curious about how the Pendragons would react to the fact that instead of thousands of Pendragons, a single Vorhelm now possessed an Ancestral Dragon Mark?
They certainly would not be happy ...
In any case, he slowly removed his hand from the black surface, and the golden lines on his arm faded away.
Only the Dragon Mark on the back of his right hand remained.
Seris was looking at him from the other side of the formation’s core, Lian curled his fingers once and then said with a faint smile,
"Looks like it accepted me."
The young Pendragon looked at his new Mark for a moment and then nodded.
"Yeah, congratulations."
The information about the new Blessing appeared in his mind.
[ Blessing: Wings of God ]
[ Ability to fly at a speed that can reach up to 3333% of the body’s base speed at its maximum ]
[ Continuous mana consumption based on flight speed and duration ]
[ Ability to fold the wings around the body and form armor that increases defensive power by up to 3333% ]
[ Against extremely powerful attacks, up to 80% of mana can be consumed for defense ]
[ Ability to create a massive tornado with power equal to 3333% of offensive power and physical strength ]
[ Cost: 70% of mana per activation ]
[ World Boundary Crossing: Locked ]
[ Unlock Requirement: Spirit stat of 100,000 ]
[ Ability to travel between worlds whose existence you are aware of ]
Lian raised his eyebrows.
Traveling between worlds? This was no longer just a combat Blessing.
If his Spirit stat ever reached one hundred thousand, he could use these wings to cross the boundaries between worlds,
And the other abilities of this Blessing were also insane, he had not expected the Blessing of a Dragon Mark to be this amazing.
He glanced at Seris, that girl also had an Ancestral Mark, so what was her Blessing like? It should not be weaker than his, right?

"I guess the Pendragons are going to be even angrier than I expected." After seeing just how amazing this Blessing could be, he became even more certain that the Pendragons’ reaction might be worse than he imagined.
In any case, now was not the time to think about that, because the real event was only just beginning.
Two black lines emerged from behind Lian’s shoulders.
At first, they looked like streams of dense mana, but their shape soon began to change.
Dark bone structures spread along them. Layers of small, tightly packed scales covered their surfaces, and huge membranes formed between the bones of the wings.
When they fully opened, two black wings stood behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 573: Wings Of God
paragraphs: The black scales overlapped each other, with shiny edges, and very thin lines of dark light flowed through some parts of the bone structure.
Their beauty was strange.
Even within the vast Prison of the Demon of End, Lian’s new wings had an appearance that was difficult to ignore.
When he spread them, the air around him was pushed backward.
The shadow of the wings covered a large part of the broken platform.
For a moment, he felt as if two new limbs had been added to his body.
He could move even the smallest parts of them, change the angle of each wing, and even feel the air pressure building beneath them.
Seris glanced at him, and it was not difficult for her to understand that he had obtained them as the Blessing of an Ancestral Dragon Mark.
But before she could ask for more details, the roar of the Demon of End shook the prison once again.
The dragon’s massive claw came down toward them.
Lian did not even have time to test all the abilities of his new wings, and could only think about moving.
The two black wings spread open.
Whoosh!
His body shot up from the platform at a terrifying speed, and for a moment, the distance between him and the Demon of End almost disappeared.
However, this speed was different from Reinar’s spatial movement.
Lian had actually moved, while that man bent space-time according to his own will.
Air pressure struck his armor, and the stones beneath the place where he had taken off shifted due to the wave of force created by his wings opening.
In the middle of his movement, he folded one of his wings.
His direction changed.
The Demon of End’s claw passed through the place where he had been a moment ago.
BOOOOOOM!
Part of the platform shattered.
Lian turned his body in the air and headed back toward Seris, but this time, instead of landing, he remained suspended several meters above the platform.
True flight, with a speed that, if he released the full power of the Blessing, would be dozens of times greater than even his maximum running speed.
Of course, he could also feel the mana consumption.
The faster he moved, the more energy left his body.
So, for now, he did not use his full capacity, saving it for a time when he truly needed it.
She looked up at him from below, and her gaze remained on his black wings for a moment.
Lian gave a faint smile.
"What do you think?"
"They’re good and... beautiful." Seris answered after a short pause.
He laughed.
"That was a huge compliment."
But the girl was no longer looking at him, she had raised her sword, and behind her, something began to take shape in the darkness.
First, two golden eyes opened, and then a deep roar echoed through the prison.
A massive amount of mana gathered behind her and slowly took shape.
A magnificent dragon’s head with long golden horns, a neck covered in silver-white scales, and two massive wings with lines of cold light flowing between them.
When the manifestation was complete, a dragon stood behind Seris.
Its body was semi-material, but the pressure of its presence was so real that even the air around the girl changed.
The moonlight that had previously formed behind her was now moving around the manifestation.
Two different powers, yet strangely in sync.

Lian looked at the scene for a moment, if he was not mistaken, this dragon manifestation should be the Blessing Seris had obtained from her Ancestral Dragon Mark, now he just needed to see what its abilities were.
The Demon of End noticed it as well, and its massive eyes remained fixed on the manifestation for a moment.
"This...
Its voice grew heavier.
"You damn Pendragons, you’re using my Dragon Pearl in such a stupid way?"
Then it raised its partially freed arm again.
Lian saw the direction of its movement.
"Seris, now!"
The girl nodded and raised her sword, while the massive manifestation of the Ancestral Dragon moved behind her as well, the concept of her Blessing was simple.
She could create a dragon phantom and combine it with her attack, and the result was an increase of up to 3333% in her attack power.
Silver mana gathered along the blade.
The moon phantom grew brighter, and the dragon behind Seris opened its mouth.
For a moment, the sounds of two roars merged.
She swung her sword downward.
At the same time, the dragon phantom followed the same path, and the power of the sword strike and the force of the manifestation merged at a single point.
CRRRRAAAAAASH!
A massive slash of silver and golden light struck the damaged part of the Demon of End’s arm.
The sound of the impact echoed throughout the prison, and several old scales that already had cracks in them shattered.
The dragon’s massive claw stopped in the middle of its movement.
Then it moved back several meters.
Even Lian was surprised by the result for a moment.
Seris was only at the first evolution, yet she had managed to push back the partially freed arm of a being in the Demon rank.
Of course, this was not because her power was truly superior, the Demon of End was still under the pressure of hundreds of chains and the central spikes.
But even under these conditions, such an attack was no small feat.
The dragon manifestation behind Seris grew fainter.
The girl took a heavy breath, half of her mana had been consumed by that single strike.
The young Vorhelm glanced at her.
"Are you okay?"
The young Pendragon nodded, but this time, it was clear that she could not repeat such an attack one after another.
The Demon of End no longer paid attention to that strike, it raised its hand, and a dark red light moved along its claws.
The space around its arm began to split apart.
Lian immediately understood the nature of the next attack when he saw the black lines.
That monster wanted to use the Essence of End.
This time, its target was not Seris, it was attacking him directly.
He spread his wings and changed direction in the air, the first rift passed beside his body, and the second appeared slightly lower.
Lian turned his body.
The third one formed directly in his escape path, the dragon was reading his movements.
For a moment, he was forced to reduce his speed sharply, but at that moment, he realized that his escape routes were being blocked one after another.
The Demon of End was using its intelligence to take advantage of the prison’s movement restrictions, it could not move its entire body freely.
So instead of chasing Lian, it was targeting the spaces he could use to escape.
Another black rift appeared, this time directly in front of his chest.
The young Vorhelm folded his right wing and turned his body sideways, the edge of the rift passed beside the armor plates.
Part of the armor covering his shoulder came apart without being directly hit, and the ancient armor beneath it cracked.
Severe pain spread through his shoulder.
Lian gritted his teeth and escaped the area.
Damn it.
If he had moved a moment later, that rift could have cut off part of his body, even with his new Blessing, he still could not stand directly against the Essence of End.
Below the platform, One and Two had also noticed the situation.
Both of them had been injured in the previous battle, One’s side armor still had deep cracks, and one of its legs could barely move.
Two was also still standing, but part of the bone armor covering its shoulder was gone.
Lian could feel their pain through the Colony Link, he had no intention of sending them into another direct clash.
But this time, the Demon of End attacked the seal.
Seris was still maintaining the energy flow of the sacrificed Dragon Marks and could not freely move away from her position.
Lian turned in the air, the distance was too great, and he would have to fly at full power to reach her.
And right at that moment, the dragon released one of its rifts of End along the direct path between them.
He was forced to take another route, but this created a delay of several seconds.
And that was enough for the Demon of End.
"Die!"
Its claw came down, targeting the place where the girl was standing.
One moved before everyone else, the massive ant leaped toward Seris, releasing the remaining energy inside its armor as several semi-material arms emerged from its back.
[ Six Hands of Ruin ]
The massive arms moved in front of the rift’s path.
The first impact destroyed one of the arms.
The second one split apart at the same moment.
The massive ant redirected all the pressure toward the ground to make the rift’s path move away from the point where she was standing.
It succeeded for a fraction of a second.
But the next wave struck its black armor directly.
CRAAAAACK!
The thick armor plates broke along its side and chest.
The massive ant’s body was lifted off the ground and slammed into one of the broken pillars.
The sound of the impact echoed through the prison.
One fell to the ground.
One of its legs had bent beneath its body, and its antennae could barely move.
For a moment, the Colony Link was filled with intense pain.
Lian gritted his teeth.
"One!"
But the attack was not over yet.
Two raised its head.

A massive pile of black bones rose between the remaining part of the rift and Seris, and the rift of End passed through the bones.
A large part of the mountain broke apart almost immediately, but that brief resistance slightly changed the attack’s path.
Two tried to jump backward.
It was too late.
The pressure wave struck its shoulder and side.
BOOOOOOM!
The bone armor covering the wolf’s body broke, and it was dragged several meters across the ground.
Then it tried to stand up... but its front legs trembled and it fell to the ground again...
